name: Acid Splash
description: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that Sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Blade Ward
description: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

name: Booming Blade
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 or more feet before then, it immediately takes 1d8 Thunder damage, and the spell ends.
higherLevel: At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage to the target on a hit, and the damage for moving increases to 2d8. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 3d8) and again at 17th level (3d8 and 4d8).

name: Chill Touch
description: Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 at levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

name: Control Flames
description: You choose nonmagical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You affect it in one of the following ways: instantaneously expand the flame 5 feet in one direction (if fuel is present); instantaneously extinguish the flames within the cube; change the flame's brightness or color for 1 hour; or cause simple shapes to appear within the flames for 1 hour. You can have up to three non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.

name: Create Bonfire
description: You create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the magic bonfire fills a 5-foot cube. Any creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Fire damage. A creature must also make the saving throw when it moves into the bonfire's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Dancing Lights
components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus)
description: You create up to four torch-size lights within range (or combine them into one glowing Medium humanlike form). Each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius. As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. Each light must stay within 20 feet of another light from this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

name: Druidcraft
description: Create one minor nature effect: predict weather for 24 hours; make a flower bloom; create a harmless sensory effect; or light/snuff a small fire.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: You hurl a beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage.
higherLevel: Two beams at level 5, three at 11, and four at 17. Beams can target the same or different targets; make a separate attack roll for each.

name: Elementalism
description: You exert minor control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range.

subEntries.label: Beckon Air
subEntries.text: A breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters in a 5-foot Cube. Held or worn items aren't affected.

subEntries.label: Beckon Earth
subEntries.text: A thin shroud of dust or sand covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or a single word appears in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.

subEntries.label: Beckon Fire
subEntries.text: A thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke fills a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps there.

subEntries.label: Beckon Water
subEntries.text: A spray of cool mist lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube, or you create 1 cup of clean water in an open container.

subEntries.label: Sculpt Element
subEntries.text: You shape dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that fits in a 1-foot Cube into a crude shape for 1 hour.

name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable uncarried object hit starts burning.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 at levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

name: Friends
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw or has the Charmed condition for the duration. It succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you've cast this spell on it in the past 24 hours. The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a saving throw. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

name: Frostbite
description: You cause numbing frost to form on one creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 1d6 Cold damage and has disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Green-Flame Blade
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause green fire to leap from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The second creature takes Fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevel: At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 Fire damage to the target on a hit, and the fire damage to the second creature increases to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level and again at 17th level.

name: Guidance
description: You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.

name: Gust
description: You seize the air and compel it to create one of the following effects at a point you can see within range: one Medium or smaller creature that you choose must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 5 feet away from you; you create a small blast of air capable of moving one object that is neither held nor carried and that weighs no more than 5 pounds. The object is pushed up to 10 feet away from you; or you create a harmless sensory effect using air, such as causing leaves to rustle, wind to slam shutters shut, or your clothing to ripple in a breeze.

name: Infestation
description: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, and other parasites to appear momentarily on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Poison damage and move 5 feet in a random direction if it can move and its speed is at least 5 feet. Roll a d4 for the direction: 1, north; 2, south; 3, east; 4, west. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Light
components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
description: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't worn or carried by someone else. It sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

name: Lightning Lure
description: You create a lash of lightning energy that strikes at one creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet in a straight line toward you and then take 1d8 Lightning damage if it is within 5 feet of you.
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral floating hand appears at a point within range. When you cast the spell, and as a Magic action on later turns, you can use it to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour out a vial; as part of that action it can move up to 30 feet. It can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds, and it vanishes if more than 30 feet from you.

name: Magic Stone
description: You touch one to three pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or someone else can make a ranged spell attack with one of the pebbles by throwing it or hurling it with a sling. If thrown, a pebble has a range of 60 feet. If someone else attacks with a pebble, that attacker adds your spellcasting ability modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier Bludgeoning damage. Whether the attack hits or misses, the spell then ends on that stone. Unused pebbles lose their magic when the spell ends.

name: Mending
description: This spell repairs a single break or tear no larger than 1 foot in an object you touch, leaving no trace of the former damage.

name: Message
description: You point at a creature and whisper a message. Only the target hears it and can reply in a whisper only you hear.

name: Mind Sliver
description: You drive a spike of psychic energy into one creature you can see. It must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 1d6 Psychic damage and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Minor Illusion
description: You create a sound (whisper to scream) or an image of an object (no larger than a 5-foot Cube; no sound, light, or smell) within range for the duration. Physical interaction reveals the image as an illusion. A creature that takes a Study action can discern the illusion with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.

name: Mold Earth
description: You choose a portion of dirt or stone that fits within a 5-foot cube within range. You choose one of the following effects: excavate it, moving material to an adjacent space; shape it into difficult terrain or return it to normal (lasts 1 hour); or cause minerals in the dirt or stone to glitter briefly, revealing them (lasts 1 hour). You can have no more than two non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.

name: Poison Spray
description: You spray toxic mist at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 Poison damage.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d12 at levels 5 (2d12), 11 (3d12), and 17 (4d12).

name: Prestidigitation
description: A minor magical trick. Create a sensory effect; light or snuff a small flame; clean or soil an object; chill, warm, or flavor material; color or mark a surface; or conjure a small illusory image.

name: Primal Savagery
description: You channel primal magic to cause your teeth or fingernails to sharpen, ready to deliver a corrosive attack. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Acid damage. After you make the attack, your teeth or fingernails return to normal.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

name: Produce Flame
description: A flame appears in your hand for the duration; it emits no heat, ignites nothing, and sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for another 20 feet. Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or object within 60 feet: make a ranged spell attack, dealing 1d8 Fire damage on a hit. The spell ends if you cast it again.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Ray of Frost
description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Resistance
description: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. When the creature takes damage of that type before the spell ends, it reduces the total damage by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on one creature you can see. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half or Three-Quarters Cover.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Shape Water
description: You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You manipulate it in one of the following ways: move or redirect the flow of the water up to 5 feet in any direction (instantaneous); cause it to form into simple shapes and animate at your direction (lasts 1 hour); change its color or opacity (lasts 1 hour); or freeze it, provided there are no creatures in it (unfreezes in 1 hour). You can have no more than two non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

name: Shillelagh
description: A Club or Quarterstaff you hold is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for its melee attack and damage rolls, its damage die becomes a d8, and its damage can be Force or its normal type (your choice). The spell ends if you cast it again or let go of the weapon.
higherLevel: Damage die becomes d10 at level 5, d12 at level 11, and 2d6 at level 17.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage and can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Sorcerous Burst
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 damage of a type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Psychic, or Thunder. Each time you roll an 8 on a d8 for this spell, roll another d8 and add it, up to a number of extra d8s equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Spare the Dying
description: Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.
higherLevel: Range doubles at levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).

name: Starry Wisp
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Radiant damage, and until the end of your next turn it sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Sword Burst
description: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you. Each creature within range, other than you, must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Force damage.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Manifest a minor wonder: boom your voice (Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks); flicker flames; cause tremors; create a sound; change your eyes; or open/slam an unlocked door or window. Lasting effects last 1 minute; up to three active at once.

name: Thorn Whip
components: V, S, M (the stem of a thorny plant)
description: A thorny vine lashes out at a creature in range. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage, and if it is Large or smaller you can pull it up to 10 feet closer to you.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Thunderclap
description: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Thunder damage. The boom can be heard up to 100 feet away.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Toll the Dead
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw or takes 1d8 Necrotic damage. If the target is missing any Hit Points, it takes 1d12 Necrotic damage instead.
higherLevel: Damage increases by one die at levels 5 (2d8/2d12), 11 (3d8/3d12), and 17 (4d8/4d12).

name: True Strike
components: S, M (a weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP)
description: Make one attack with the casting weapon using your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Radiant or the weapon's normal damage type.
higherLevel: The attack deals extra Radiant damage at levels 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), and 17 (3d6).

name: Vicious Mockery
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw or takes 1d6 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Word of Radiance
description: Burning radiance erupts from you in a 5-foot Emanation. Each creature of your choice you can see there must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Radiant damage.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Absorb Elements
castTime: Reaction, which you take when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage
description: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. You have resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. Also, the first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering type, and the spell ends.
higherLevel: The extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Alarm
components: V, S, M (a bell and silver wire)
description: You set an alarm on a door, window, or area no larger than a 20-foot Cube. Whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area, the alarm triggers; you can designate creatures that won't set it off. Choose an audible alarm (a handbell sound for 10 seconds, heard within 60 feet) or a mental alarm (pings you if you're within 1 mile, waking you if asleep).

name: Animal Friendship
components: V, S, M (a morsel of food)
description: Target a Beast you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The spell ends if you or an ally harms the target.
higherLevel: Target one additional Beast per slot level above 1.

name: Armor of Agathys
components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
description: Protective magical frost surrounds you. You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. Until the spell ends, a creature that hits you with a melee attack roll takes 5 Cold damage. The spell ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points left.
higherLevel: Temporary HP and Cold damage each increase by 5 per slot level above 1.

name: Arms of Hadar
description: Dark tendrils erupt from you. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Strength saving throw: on a failure it takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn; on a success it takes half damage only.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Bane
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
description: Up to three creatures make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, whenever a target makes an attack roll or saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from the roll.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Bless
components: V, S, M (a Holy Symbol worth 5+ GP)
description: Up to three creatures of your choice within range can roll 1d4 and add it to each attack roll or saving throw they make for the duration.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Burning Hands
description: A thin sheet of flames shoots from your outstretched fingers. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, 3d6 Fire damage; half on success. Flammable uncarried objects ignite.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Catapult
description: Choose one object weighing 1 to 5 pounds within range that isn't being worn or carried. The object flies in a straight line up to 90 feet in a direction you choose before falling to the ground, stopping early if it impacts against a solid surface. If the object would strike a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object strikes the target and stops moving. When the object strikes something, the object and what it strikes each take 3d8 Bludgeoning damage.
higherLevel: The maximum weight of objects that you can target with this spell increases by 5 pounds, and the damage increases by 2d8, for each slot level above 1st.

name: Cause Fear
description: You awaken the sense of mortality in one creature you can see within range. A Construct or Undead is immune to this effect. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the spell ends. The frightened target can repeat its saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
higherLevel: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Charm Person
description: One Humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw, with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, it has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it, and it is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Chromatic Orb
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 50+ GP)
description: Hurl an orb of energy at a target. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, then make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 3d8 damage of that type. If two or more of the d8s show the same number, the orb leaps to a different target within 30 feet of the last one, making a new attack roll.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1. The orb can leap a number of times equal to the slot level, and a creature can be targeted only once per casting.

name: Color Spray
components: V, S, M (a pinch of colorful sand)
description: A dazzling burst of colored light fills a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Command
description: You speak a one-word command. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn.

subEntries.label: Approach
subEntries.text: The target moves toward you by the shortest route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.

subEntries.label: Drop
subEntries.text: The target drops whatever it is holding and ends its turn.

subEntries.label: Flee
subEntries.text: The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest means.

subEntries.label: Grovel
subEntries.text: The target falls Prone and ends its turn.

subEntries.label: Halt
subEntries.text: The target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

higherLevel: Affect one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Compelled Duel
description: You compel a creature into a duel. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone other than you, and it can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you. The spell ends if you attack another creature, cast a spell on another enemy, an ally damages the target, or you end your turn more than 30 feet from it.

name: Comprehend Languages
components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot and salt)
description: You understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear and any written language you see (requires touching the surface). Takes about 1 minute to read one page. Doesn't decode secret messages.

name: Create or Destroy Water
components: V, S, M (a mix of water and sand)
description: You either create or destroy water.

subEntries.label: Create Water
subEntries.text: Create up to 10 gallons of clean water in an open container, or make it fall as rain in a 30-foot Cube, extinguishing exposed flames there.

subEntries.label: Destroy Water
subEntries.text: Destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container, or destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube.

higherLevel: Create or destroy 10 additional gallons, or increase the Cube's size by 5 feet, per slot level above 1.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevel: Healing increases by 2d8 per slot level above 1.

name: Detect Evil and Good
description: For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of you. You also sense whether the Hallow spell is active there and, if so, where. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or a thin sheet of lead.

name: Detect Magic
description: You sense magical effects within 30 feet. You can take a Magic action to see the aura around magic items or affected creatures and learn the school of magic involved.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of you, and you identify the kind in each case. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or a thin sheet of lead.

name: Disguise Self
description: You (including clothing and gear) look different until the spell ends: up to 1 foot shorter or taller, heavier or lighter, but with the same basic arrangement of limbs. The illusion fails physical inspection. To discern it, a creature must take the Study action and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and must immediately use its Reaction, if available, to move as far away from you as it can by the safest route. On a success, half damage only.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Divine Favor
description: Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.

name: Divine Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The target you just hit takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

name: Earth Tremor
description: You cause a tremor in the ground within range. Each creature other than you in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. If the ground in that area is loose earth or stone, it becomes difficult terrain until cleared, with each 5-foot-diameter portion requiring at least 1 minute to clear by hand.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Ensnaring Strike
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon
description: Grasping vines appear where your weapon hit. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (Large or larger creatures have Advantage) or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. While Restrained, it takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. It or a creature within reach can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Entangle
description: Grasping plants sprout in a 20-foot square, making it Difficult Terrain. Each creature (other than you) in the area when cast must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: You take the Dash action and can take it as a Bonus Action until the spell ends.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in colored light, and each creature there is outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. Outlined objects and creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition. Attack rolls against them have Advantage if the attacker can see them.

name: False Life
components: V, S, M (a drop of alcohol)
description: You gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points.
higherLevel: Gain 5 additional Temporary Hit Points per slot level above 1.

name: Feather Fall
castTime: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls
components: V, M (a small feather or piece of down)
description: Up to five falling creatures within range slow their descent to 60 feet per round. If a creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no fall damage, and the spell ends for that creature.

name: Find Familiar
components: V, S, M (burning incense worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You gain a familiar in the form of a Beast of Challenge Rating 0 (Bat, Cat, Owl, Raven, etc.); it is a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice). It obeys you and acts on its own Initiative but can't attack. Within 100 feet you share telepathy, and as a Bonus Action you can use its senses until the start of your next turn. It can deliver your touch spells using its Reaction. At 0 HP it disappears until recast; you can dismiss or recall it (within 30 feet) as a Magic action.

name: Fog Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as from Gust of Wind) disperses it.
higherLevel: Radius increases by 20 feet per slot level above 1.

name: Goodberry
components: V, S, M (a sprig of mistletoe)
description: Ten magic berries appear in your hand. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry, which restores 1 Hit Point and provides a day's nourishment. Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

name: Grease
components: V, S, M (a bit of pork rind or butter)
description: Slick grease covers a 10-foot square, making it Difficult Terrain. Each creature standing there when it appears must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on the save or fall Prone.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Hail of Thorns
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon
description: Your attack sprays thorns. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d10 Piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevel: Healing increases by 2d4 per slot level above 1.

name: Hellish Rebuke
castTime: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself
description: The creature that damaged you is wreathed in hellish flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature you touch is immune to the Frightened condition and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Hex
components: V, S, M (the petrified eye of a newt)
description: You curse a creature you can see. You deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Choose one ability; the target has Disadvantage on ability checks with that ability. If the target drops to 0 HP, you can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.
higherLevel: Concentration lasts up to 4 hours (level 2), 8 hours (3–4), or 24 hours (5+).

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Magically mark one creature you can see as your quarry. You deal an extra 1d6 Force damage whenever you hit it with an attack roll, and have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception or Survival) checks to find it. If the target drops to 0 HP, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.
higherLevel: Duration: 8 hours (3–4), 24 hours (5+).

name: Ice Knife
components: S, M (a drop of water or a piece of ice)
description: You fling a shard of ice. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d10 Piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard then explodes: the target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 Cold damage.
higherLevel: Cold damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Identify
components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100+ GP)
description: You learn a magic item's properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement, and how many charges it has. You also learn what spells are affecting it, or if touching a creature, what spells affect it.

name: Illusory Script
components: S, M (ink worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You write a message on parchment or paper that only creatures you designate can read; to everyone else it looks like unintelligible script or a different message of your choice. The spell ends if dispelled. Truesight reveals the hidden message.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: A creature you touch makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

name: Jump
components: V, S, M (a grasshopper's hind leg)
description: You touch a willing creature. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Longstrider
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
description: The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Mage Armor
components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
description: You touch a willing creature not wearing armor. Its base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor.

name: Magic Missile
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart automatically hits a creature you can see and deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage. The darts all strike simultaneously and can target the same or different creatures.
higherLevel: The spell creates one more dart per slot level above 1.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
components: V, S, M (a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: One willing creature you touch is protected against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. Such creatures have Disadvantage on attacks against the target, and the target can't be Charmed, Frightened, or Possessed by them.

name: Purify Food and Drink
description: You remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range.

name: Ray of Sickness
description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

name: Sanctuary
components: V, S, M (a shard of glass from a mirror)
description: You ward a creature against attack. A creature that targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must first succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. Area effects aren't stopped. The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.

name: Searing Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: As you hit, the target takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage. At the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, it takes 1d6 Fire damage and then makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevel: Both the initial and ongoing damage increase by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Shield
castTime: Reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell
description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Silent Image
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
description: You create a purely visual image of an object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot Cube. It makes no sound, smell, or other sensory effect. You can take a Magic action to move the image within range and change its appearance. Physical interaction reveals it as an illusion, and a creature can take a Study action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it.

name: Sleep
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand or rose petals)
description: Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save; on a second failure it has the Unconscious condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet takes an action to shake it awake. Creatures that don't sleep or are immune to Exhaustion automatically succeed.

name: Snare
components: S, M (25 feet of rope, which the spell consumes)
description: As you cast this spell, you use the rope to create a circle with a 5-foot radius on the ground. When you finish casting, the rope disappears and the circle becomes a magic trap. The trap triggers when a Small, Medium, or Large creature moves onto the ground in the spell's radius. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be magically hoisted into the air, leaving it hanging upside down 3 feet above the ground. The creature is restrained there until the spell ends or until someone uses their action to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell save DC to free the creature. The trap requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to notice.

name: Speak with Animals
description: For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them. Most Beasts have limited knowledge, but they can share information about nearby locations and creatures they've seen recently.

name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
components: V, S, M (a bit of rotten food)
description: A stream of acid emanates from you in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for the spell's duration or until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash off the acid. A creature covered in the acid takes 2d4 Acid damage at the start of each of its turns.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
components: V, S, M (a tart and a feather)
description: One creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or collapse in fits of laughter, gaining the Prone and Incapacitated conditions; it can't stand up for the duration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with Advantage if the save is triggered by damage), ending the spell on a success.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury)
description: A flat, circular 3-foot-diameter plane of force appears 3 feet above the ground and holds up to 500 pounds. It stays within 20 feet of you, following as you move, but can't cross elevation changes of 10 feet or more. If you move more than 100 feet away or the load exceeds its capacity, the spell ends and its contents fall.

name: Thunderous Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Your strike rings with thunder audible within 300 feet and deals an extra 2d6 Thunder damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and have the Prone condition.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Thunderwave
description: Each creature in a 15-foot Cube makes a Constitution save. On a failed save, 2d8 Thunder damage and pushed 10 feet; on success, half damage only. Unsecured objects are automatically pushed. Audible 300 feet away.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

name: Unseen Servant
components: V, S, M (a bit of string and of wood)
description: An Invisible, mindless, shapeless Medium force performs simple tasks at your command. It has AC 10, 1 HP, Strength 2, and can't attack; the spell ends if it drops to 0 HP. Once on each of your turns as a Bonus Action, you can command it to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. The spell ends if a task would move it more than 60 feet from you.

name: Witch Bolt
components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)
description: A beam of lightning arcs to a creature in range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 2d12 Lightning damage. On each of your later turns, you can take a Bonus Action to deal 1d12 Lightning damage to the target automatically, even if the first attack missed. The spell ends early if the target is outside range or has Total Cover from you.
higherLevel: Initial damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 1.

name: Wrathful Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Your strike deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Zephyr Strike
description: You move like the wind. Until the spell ends, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Once before the spell ends, you can give yourself advantage on one weapon attack roll on your turn. That attack deals an extra 1d8 Force damage on a hit. Whether you hit or miss, your walking speed increases by 30 feet until the end of that turn.

name: Aganazzar's Scorcher
components: V, S, M (a red dragon's scale)
description: A line of roaring flame 30 feet long and 5 feet wide emanates from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Aid
components: V, S, M (a strip of white cloth)
description: Up to three creatures' Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points each increase by 5 for the duration.
higherLevel: Increase by an additional 5 per slot level above 2.

name: Alter Self
description: You alter your physical form. Choose one of the options below; while the spell lasts, you can take a Magic action to swap to a different option.

subEntries.label: Aquatic Adaptation
subEntries.text: You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

subEntries.label: Change Appearance
subEntries.text: You decide your height, weight, features, voice, hair, coloration, and even apparent species, but your statistics don't change. You can't appear as a different size, and your basic shape stays the same. You can take a Magic action to change your appearance again.

subEntries.label: Natural Weapons
subEntries.text: You grow claws (Slashing), fangs or horns (Piercing), or hooves (Bludgeoning). Your Unarmed Strikes with them deal 1d6 damage of that type and use your spellcasting ability modifier for attack and damage rolls instead of Strength.

name: Animal Messenger
components: V, S, M (a morsel of food)
description: A Tiny Beast you can see makes a Charisma save (it automatically succeeds unless its Challenge Rating is 0); on a failure, it carries a message of up to 25 words to a location you have visited and a recipient matching a general description. It travels about 25 miles per 24 hours (50 miles if it can fly) and delivers the message by mimicking your communication. If it doesn't arrive before the spell ends, the message is lost and the Beast returns to where you cast the spell.
higherLevel: Duration increases by 48 hours per slot level above 2.

name: Arcane Lock
components: V, S, M (gold dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch and magically lock it for the duration. It can't be unlocked by any nonmagical means. You and creatures you designate when you cast the spell can open and close it normally. You can also set a password that, spoken within 5 feet of the object, unlocks it for 1 minute.

name: Arcane Vigor
description: You tap into your life force. Expend up to two of your unexpended Hit Point Dice and roll them; you regain Hit Points equal to the total plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevel: You can expend one additional Hit Die per slot level above 2.

name: Augury
components: V, S, M (specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or other divinatory tokens worth 25+ GP)
description: You receive an omen about the results of a course of action you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM chooses Weal (good), Woe (bad), Weal and woe (both), or Indifference (neither). If you cast it more than once before a Long Rest, each casting after the first has a cumulative 25% chance of getting no answer.

name: Barkskin
components: V, S, M (a handful of bark)
description: A willing creature's skin takes on a bark-like texture. Its Armor Class can't be less than 17 for the duration.

name: Beast Sense
description: You touch a willing Beast. For the duration, you can perceive through its senses as well as your own. While doing so, you benefit from any special senses it has.

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: One creature that you can see makes a Constitution saving throw or gains the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice). The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 2.

name: Blur
description: Your body becomes blurred. For the duration, any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker that perceives you with Blindsight or Truesight is immune to this effect.

name: Calm Emotions
description: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, choose one effect for each creature: it has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions (existing ones are suppressed) until the spell ends; or it becomes Indifferent toward creatures of your choice it's Hostile toward, ending if it takes damage or sees its allies take damage.

name: Cloud of Daggers
components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
description: You fill a 5-foot Cube with spinning daggers. Each creature in it takes 4d4 Slashing damage. A creature also takes this damage when it enters the Cube, ends its turn there, or the Cube moves into its space, but only once per turn. On later turns, you can take a Magic action to teleport the Cube up to 30 feet.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 2.

name: Continual Flame
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A flame springs from an object you touch, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It looks like a regular flame but creates no heat and uses no fuel. It can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

name: Cordon of Arrows
description: You touch up to four nonmagical arrows or bolts and plant them in your space; they can't be pulled up. When a creature other than you enters within 30 feet of them for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one piece flies at it: Dexterity save or take 2d4 Piercing damage, then the piece is destroyed. You can designate creatures the spell ignores. The spell ends when no ammunition remains.
higherLevel: Two additional pieces of ammunition per slot level above 2.

name: Crown of Madness
description: A creature you can see must succeed on a Wisdom save or have the Charmed condition; non-Humanoids succeed automatically. While Charmed, before moving on each of its turns it must use its action to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose (it acts normally if you choose none or none is in reach). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success. On your later turns, you must take a Magic action to maintain control, or the spell ends.

name: Darkness
components: V, M (bat fur and a piece of coal)
description: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Darkvision can't see through it and nonmagical light can't illuminate it. Alternatively, cast it on an object not worn or carried to fill a 15-foot Emanation from it; covering the object with something opaque blocks the Darkness. Overlapping light from spells of level 2 or lower is dispelled.

name: Darkvision
description: A willing creature gains Darkvision with a range of 150 feet for the duration.

name: Detect Thoughts
description: Activate one effect, then either as a Magic action on later turns. Sense Thoughts: sense creatures within 30 feet that know languages or are telepathic (blocked by 1 ft of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or thin lead). Read Thoughts: learn what is most on the mind of one such creature within 30 feet. As a Magic action on your next turn, probe deeper: the target makes a Wisdom save. On a failure, you learn its reasoning, emotions, and something looming in its mind; on a success, the spell ends. The target knows, and can take an action to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your DC to end the spell.

name: Dragon's Breath
description: A willing creature can take a Magic action to exhale energy in a 15-foot Cone. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison when you cast. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity save: 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a fail, half on success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Dust Devil
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust)
description: Choose an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air that you can see within range. An elemental force resembling a dust devil appears in the cube and lasts for the spell's duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the dust devil must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d8 Bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet away. On a successful save, it takes half damage and isn't pushed. As a Bonus Action, you can move the dust devil up to 30 feet. If it moves over sand, dust, or loose dirt, it creates a 10-foot-radius cloud of debris lasting until the start of your next turn that heavily obscures its area.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Earthbind
description: Choose one creature you can see within range. Yellow strips of magical energy loop around the creature. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or its flying speed (if any) is reduced to 0 feet for the spell's duration. An airborne creature affected by this spell safely descends at 60 feet per round until it reaches the ground or the spell ends.

name: Enhance Ability
components: V, S, M (fur or a feather)
description: You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For the duration, the target has Advantage on ability checks using the chosen ability.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 2. You can choose a different ability for each target.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered iron)
description: A creature or an object (not worn or carried) you can see grows or shrinks for the duration, along with everything it wears and carries. An unwilling creature makes a Constitution save; on a success, the spell has no effect.

subEntries.label: Enlarge
subEntries.text: Size increases by one category. Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saves. Attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage.

subEntries.label: Reduce
subEntries.text: Size decreases by one category. Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saves. Attacks with its reduced weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage (minimum 1).

name: Enthrall
description: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range make a Wisdom saving throw. Any creature you or your companions are fighting automatically succeeds. On a failed save, a target has a -10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception until the spell ends.

name: Find Steed
description: You summon an otherworldly being that appears as a loyal Large steed of your choice, using the Otherworldly Steed stat block; choose its type (Celestial, Fey, or Fiend) each casting. It shares your Initiative and acts as a controlled mount while you ride it; if you're Incapacitated, it acts independently to protect you. It disappears if it drops to 0 Hit Points or you die. Casting again replaces any steed you already have.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the slot level in the stat block.

name: Find Traps
description: You sense any trap within range that is in line of sight (any object or mechanism created to cause damage or danger, including spells like Alarm or Glyph of Warding). You learn that a trap is present and the general nature of its danger, but not its location.

name: Flame Blade
description: You evoke a fiery scimitar-sized blade in your free hand. If you let go, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a Bonus Action. As a Magic action, make a melee spell attack with it; on a hit, the target takes 3d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier Fire damage. The blade sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Flaming Sphere
components: V, S, M (a ball of wax)
description: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space on the ground. Any creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save: 2d6 Fire on a fail, half on success. Bonus Action: roll it up to 30 feet; if it enters a creature's space, that creature makes the save and the sphere stops for the turn. It ignites unattended flammable objects and sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Gentle Repose
components: V, S, M (2 Copper Pieces, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, it is protected from decay and can't become Undead. The duration also doesn't count against the time limit of spells like Raise Dead.

name: Gust of Wind
description: A Line of wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you. Each creature in the Line makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 feet away along the Line; a creature that ends its turn in the Line makes the same save. Moving closer to you in the Line costs 2 feet per 1 foot. It disperses gas and extinguishes unprotected flames. As a Bonus Action on later turns, you can change its direction.

name: Healing Spirit
description: You call forth a nature spirit to soothe the wounded. The intangible spirit appears in a space that is a 5-foot cube you can see within range. The spirit looks like a transparent beast or fey (your choice). Until the spell ends, whenever you or a creature you can see moves into the spirit's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, you can cause the spirit to restore 1d6 Hit Points to that creature (no action required). The spirit can't heal Constructs or Undead. As a Bonus Action, you can move the spirit up to 30 feet to a space you can see. The spirit can heal a number of times equal to 1 + your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of twice). After healing that number of times, the spirit disappears.
higherLevel: The healing increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Heat Metal
components: V, S, M (a piece of iron and a flame)
description: A manufactured metal object you can see glows red-hot. Any creature in contact with it takes 2d8 Fire damage. If a creature is holding or wearing it, it makes a Constitution save or drops it; if it doesn't drop it, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until your next turn. As a Bonus Action on later turns, you can deal the damage again.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

name: Hold Person
components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)
description: One Humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw or has the Paralyzed condition for the duration. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
higherLevel: Target one additional Humanoid per slot level above 2.

name: Homunculus Servant
components: V, S, M (a gem, crystal, reliquary, or other ornamental object worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch the ornamental object and transform it into a Tiny Construct that resembles a dragon, frog, or other creature you choose. The construct uses the Homunculus Servant stat block. It is your companion for the duration, and it disappears if you die. The homunculus acts on your Initiative but takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you), and it has its own turn if you are incapacitated. If the homunculus is killed, you can cast this spell again to create a new one.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the homunculus gains 10 Temporary Hit Points for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Invisibility
components: V, S, M (an eyelash in gum arabic)
description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early for a target immediately after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 2.

name: Knock
description: One object you can see that is locked, stuck, or barred by mundane means becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If it has multiple locks, only one is unlocked. If it's held shut by Arcane Lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes. A loud knock, audible up to 300 feet away, emanates from the target.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

name: Levitate
description: One creature or loose object (up to 500 lb) you can see rises up to 20 feet vertically and remains suspended. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution save is unaffected. The target can move only by pushing or pulling against fixed surfaces, as if climbing. You can change its altitude by up to 20 feet on your turn (as part of your move if you're the target, otherwise as a Magic action). When the spell ends, it floats gently to the ground.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
components: V, S, M (fur from a bloodhound)
description: Name a specific kind of Beast, Plant creature, or nonmagical plant. You learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any is present.

name: Locate Object
description: Describe or name an object familiar to you. You sense the direction to it if it's within 1,000 feet, or to the nearest object of a kind you name. You can't locate an object you've never seen up close, and any thickness of lead blocks the spell.

name: Magic Mouth
components: V, S, M (jade dust worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You implant a message of up to 25 words in an object, to be spoken over up to 10 minutes when a trigger condition you set occurs within 30 feet. A magical mouth appears on the object and recites the message in your voice. The spell can trigger once or every time the condition occurs.

name: Magic Weapon
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The spell ends early if you cast it again.
higherLevel: Bonus increases to +2 with a level 3–5 slot and +3 with a level 6+ slot.

name: Maximilian's Earthen Grasp
components: V, S, M (a miniature hand sculpted from clay)
description: You choose a 5-foot square of ground that you can see within range. A Medium hand made from compacted soil rises there and reaches for one creature you can see within 5 feet of it. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and is restrained for the spell's duration. As an action, you can cause the hand to crush the restrained target, which must make a Strength saving throw. The target takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. To break free, the restrained target can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. As an action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet to a different spot within range and repeat its attack.

name: Melf's Acid Arrow
description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, it takes half the initial damage only.
higherLevel: Both initial and later damage increase by 1d4 per slot level above 2.

name: Mind Spike
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom save: 3d8 Psychic damage on a fail, half on success. On a failure, you always know its location for the duration, but only while you are on the same plane, and it gains no benefit from the Invisible condition against you.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself move with you and mimic your actions. Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll, roll a d6 for each remaining duplicate; if any rolls 3 or higher, a duplicate is hit and destroyed instead. Duplicates ignore all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three are destroyed. Creatures that are Blinded or have Blindsight or Truesight are unaffected.

name: Misty Step
description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Moonbeam
description: A 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of pale light fills with Dim Light. Each creature in it when it appears, when it moves into the creature's space, or when the creature enters it or ends its turn there makes a Constitution save (once per turn): 2d10 Radiant damage on a fail, half on success. A shape-shifted creature that fails reverts to its true form and can't shape-shift until it leaves. As a Magic action on later turns, you can move the Cylinder up to 60 feet.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 2.

name: Nystul's Magic Aura
components: V, S, M (a small square of silk)
description: You place an illusion on a willing creature (Mask) or an object not worn or carried (False Aura). If you cast it on the same target every day for 30 days, the illusion lasts until dispelled.

subEntries.label: False Aura
subEntries.text: Spells and effects that detect magical auras see a nonmagical object as magical, a magic item as nonmagical, or its aura as a school of magic of your choice.

subEntries.label: Mask
subEntries.text: Choose a creature type other than the target's. Spells and other magical effects treat the target as that creature type.

name: Pass without Trace
components: V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe)
description: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

name: Phantasmal Force
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
description: A creature you can see makes an Intelligence save. On a failure, you create a phantasmal object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 10-foot Cube that only the target perceives and believes is real. The target can take a Study action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your DC to disbelieve. A harmful phantasm can deal 2d8 Psychic damage to the target once per turn while it's in or within 5 feet of it.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: Up to five creatures of your choice who remain within range for the entire casting gain the benefits of a Short Rest and also regain 2d8 Hit Points. A creature can't be affected by this spell again until it finishes a Long Rest.
higherLevel: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

name: Protection from Poison
description: You touch a creature and end the Poisoned condition on it. For the duration, it has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition and Resistance to Poison damage.

name: Pyrotechnics
description: Choose an area of nonmagical flame that you can see and that fits within a 5-foot cube within range. You can extinguish the fire in that area, and you create either fireworks or smoke when you do so. Fireworks: The target explodes with a dazzling display of colors. Each creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the end of your next turn. Smoke: Thick black smoke spreads out from the target in a 20-foot radius. The area of the smoke is heavily obscured. The smoke persists for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: A creature within range makes a Constitution save. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 1d8 from all its damage rolls; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success. On a successful initial save, it has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Rope Trick
components: V, S, M (a segment of rope)
description: You touch a rope. One end hovers upward until the rope hangs perpendicular to the ground or reaches a ceiling, and an Invisible 3-by-5-foot portal opens at its top to an extradimensional space holding up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. The rope can be pulled into the space. Attacks, spells, and other effects can't pass in or out, but creatures inside can see through the portal. When the spell ends, anything inside drops out.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You hurl three rays of fire. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray; on a hit the target takes 2d6 Fire damage. The rays can hit one or multiple targets.
higherLevel: One additional ray per slot level above 2.

name: See Invisibility
components: V, S, M (a pinch of talc)
description: For the duration, you see creatures and objects that have the Invisible condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane, where creatures and objects appear ghostly.

name: Shadow Blade
description: You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. This magic sword lasts until the spell ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. It deals 2d8 Psychic damage on a hit and has the Finesse, Light, and Thrown properties (range 20/60). In addition, when you use the sword to attack a target that is in dim light or darkness, you make the attack roll with advantage. If you drop the weapon or throw it, it dissipates at the end of the turn. While the spell persists, you can use a Bonus Action to cause the sword to reappear in your hand.
higherLevel: The damage increases to 3d8 for a 3rd or 4th level slot, 4d8 for a 5th or 6th level slot, and 5d8 for a 7th level or higher slot.

name: Shatter
components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)
description: A loud noise erupts from a point you choose. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save: 3d8 Thunder damage on a fail, half on success. A Construct has Disadvantage on the save. Nonmagical objects in the area that aren't worn or carried also take the damage.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

name: Shining Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The target takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, it sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can't benefit from the Invisible condition.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Silence
description: No sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Any creature or object entirely inside has Immunity to Thunder damage, and creatures have the Deafened condition while entirely inside. Casting a spell with a Verbal component is impossible there.

name: Skywrite
description: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words appear to be made of cloud and remain in place for the spell's duration. The words dissipate when the spell ends. A strong wind can disperse the clouds and end the spell early.

name: Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
components: V, S, M (a piece of ice or a small white rock chip)
description: A flurry of magic snowballs erupts from a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 Cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Spider Climb
components: V, S, M (a drop of bitumen and a spider)
description: A willing creature gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings while leaving its hands free. It also gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 2.

name: Spike Growth
description: The ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere sprouts hard spikes and thorns, becoming Difficult Terrain. A creature moving into or within the area takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet traveled. The area is camouflaged; a creature that couldn't see it when cast must take a Search action and succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check against your DC to recognize it as hazardous.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: You create a floating spectral force resembling a weapon. When cast, make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage on a hit. As a Bonus Action on later turns, you can move it up to 20 feet and repeat the attack.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

name: Suggestion
description: You suggest a course of activity (25 words or fewer) to a creature you can see that can hear and understand you. It must sound achievable and not obviously harm the target or its allies. The target makes a Wisdom save or has the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies damage it, pursuing the suggestion as best it can. The spell ends early for the target if it completes the activity.

name: Summon Beast
components: V, S, M (a feather, tuft of fur, and fish tail inside a gilded acorn worth 200+ GP)
description: You call forth a bestial spirit using the Bestial Spirit stat block, choosing an Air, Land, or Water environment. It is an ally to you, shares your Initiative, and obeys your verbal commands (no action required). It disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Tasha's Mind Whip
description: You psychically lash out at one creature you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 3d6 Psychic damage, and it can't take a reaction until the end of its next turn. Moreover, on its next turn, it must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a Bonus Action; it gets only one of the three. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers none of the other effects.
higherLevel: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Vortex Warp
description: You magically twist space around another creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (the target can choose to fail), or the target is teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The chosen space must be on the ground or on a floor.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range of the spell increases to 600 feet.

name: Warding Bond
components: V, S, M (a pair of platinum rings worth 50+ GP each, which you and the target must wear for the duration)
description: A willing creature gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws and Resistance to all damage. Each time it takes damage, you take the same amount. The spell ends if you drop to 0 HP or you and the target are more than 60 feet apart.

name: Warding Wind
description: A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you. The wind has the following effects: it deafens you and other creatures in its area; it extinguishes unprotected flames in its area of torch size or smaller; it hedges out vapor, gas, and fog; the area is difficult terrain for creatures other than you; ranged weapon attack rolls have disadvantage if the attacks pass in or out of the wind.

name: Web
components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)
description: Sticky webbing fills a 20-foot Cube, becoming Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured. Unanchored webs collapse and the spell ends at the start of your next turn. The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity save or has the Restrained condition while in the webs. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your DC to break free. Each 5-foot Cube of web exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 Fire damage to creatures starting their turn in it.

name: Wither and Bloom
components: V, S, M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
description: You invoke both death and life upon a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. Each creature of your choice in that area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Nonmagical plants in that area that aren't creatures wither and die instantly. Additionally, one creature of your choice in that area can spend and roll one of its unspent Hit Dice and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Zone of Truth
description: You create a 15-foot-radius Sphere that guards against deception. A creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Charisma save; on a failure it can't speak a deliberate lie while in the area. You know whether each creature succeeds or fails, and affected creatures are aware of the spell.

name: Animate Dead
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)
description: Turn a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid into a Skeleton or Zombie under your control. As a Bonus Action you can mentally command any creature you made with this spell within 60 feet. Control lasts 24 hours; recast the spell before then to reassert control over up to four creatures.
higherLevel: Animate or reassert control over two additional Undead per slot level above 3.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: Healing energy radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation. When you create the aura and at the start of each of your turns while it persists, you can restore 2d6 Hit Points to one creature in it (including you).

name: Beacon of Hope
description: Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.

name: Bestow Curse
description: You touch a creature which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for the duration. Choose one: Disadvantage on one ability's checks and saves; Disadvantage on attack rolls against you; in combat, must succeed on a Wisdom save at the start of each of its turns or take the Dodge action that turn; or your attack rolls and spells that damage it deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage.
higherLevel: Level 4 slot: Concentration up to 10 minutes. Level 5+ slot: no Concentration, duration 8 hours (5–6), 24 hours (7–8), or until dispelled (9).

name: Blinding Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
