description: Your strike flares with light, dealing an extra 3d8 Radiant damage to the target, which has the Blinded condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Blinded target makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success.
higherLevel: Extra damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Blink
description: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns. On a 4–6 you vanish into the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn, then return to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of where you vanished. While ethereal you can only affect and be affected by other creatures on that plane.

name: Call Lightning
description: A storm cloud appears as a 10-foot-tall, 60-foot-radius Cylinder above a point you can see. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on later turns, call a bolt down at a point under the cloud: each creature within 5 feet of it makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 Lightning damage on a failure or half on success. If cast outdoors in stormy conditions, the bolt deals an extra 1d10.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

name: Catnap
description: You make a calming gesture, and up to three willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range fall unconscious for the spell's duration. The spell ends on a target early if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. If a target remains unconscious for the full duration, it gains the benefit of a Short Rest, and it can't be affected by this spell again until it finishes a Long Rest.
higherLevel: You can target one additional willing creature for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Clairvoyance
components: V, S, M (a focus worth 100+ GP, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing)
description: Create an Invisible, intangible sensor at a familiar or obvious location within range. Choose seeing or hearing; you perceive through the sensor as if you were there, and can switch senses with a Bonus Action. A creature that can see Invisible things sees the sensor as a luminous orb.

name: Conjure Animals
description: Summon a Large, intangible pack of spectral animals in an unoccupied space. When you move on your turn, you can also move the pack up to 30 feet. Whenever the pack moves within 10 feet of a creature you can see, or such a creature enters a space within 10 feet of the pack or ends its turn there, you can force a Dexterity save, dealing 3d10 Slashing damage on a failure (once per turn). You have Advantage on Strength saves while within 5 feet of the pack.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

name: Conjure Barrage
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: You brandish the weapon and spectral copies (or matching ammunition) launch forward, then vanish. Each creature of your choice you can see in a 60-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failure or half on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Counterspell
castTime: Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components
description: You attempt to interrupt a creature casting a spell. It makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the spell dissipates with no effect and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If the spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

name: Create Food and Water
description: Create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of fresh water on the ground or in containers within range. The food is bland but nourishing and looks like a food of your choice, and the water is clean. The food spoils after 24 hours if uneaten.

name: Crusader's Mantle
description: You radiate a 30-foot Emanation of holy power. While in it, you and your allies each deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage when hitting with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

name: Daylight
description: Sunlight fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range: Bright Light, plus Dim Light for another 60 feet. Alternatively, cast it on an object that isn't being worn or carried to fill a 60-foot Emanation from it; covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. It dispels any overlapping Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Any spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends automatically. For each spell of level 4 or higher, make an ability check (DC 10 + spell's level) to end it.
higherLevel: Auto-end any spell of a level equal to or less than the slot level used.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes magical. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder: the weapon grants +1 to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of that type on a hit.
higherLevel: Level 5–6 slot: +2 bonus and 2d4 extra damage. Level 7+ slot: +3 bonus and 3d4 extra damage.

name: Enemies Abound
description: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. A creature automatically succeeds if it is immune to being Frightened. On a failed save, the target loses the ability to distinguish friend from foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies until the spell ends. Each time the target takes damage, it can repeat its saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Whenever the affected creature chooses another creature as a target, it must choose the target randomly from among the creatures it can see within range of the attack, spell, or other ability it's using.

name: Erupting Earth
components: V, S, M (a piece of obsidian)
description: Choose a point you can see on the ground within range. A fountain of churned earth and stone erupts in a 20-foot cube centered on that point. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d12 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, the ground in that area becomes difficult terrain until cleared, with each 5-foot-square portion requiring at least 1 minute to clear by hand.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Fear
description: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Wisdom save or drops what it's holding and has the Frightened condition for the duration. A Frightened creature takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route each turn. If it ends its turn without line of sight to you, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

name: Feign Death
components: V, S, M (a pinch of graveyard dirt)
description: A willing creature you touch appears dead to all outward inspection and to spells used to determine its status. It has the Blinded and Incapacitated conditions, its Speed is 0, it has Resistance to all damage except Psychic, and it has Immunity to the Poisoned condition.

name: Fireball
components: V, S, M (a ball of bat guano and sulfur)
description: An explosion of flame bursts from a point you choose. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Dexterity save: 8d6 Fire on a fail, half on success. Fire ignites flammable uncarried objects.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Flame Arrows
description: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts. When a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using a piece of ammunition drawn from the quiver, the target takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage. The spell's magic ends on the piece of ammunition when it hits or misses, and the spell ends when twelve pieces of ammunition have been drawn from the quiver.
higherLevel: The number of pieces of ammunition you can affect with this spell increases by two for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Fly
description: The touched willing creature gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet. When the spell ends, the target falls if still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 3.

name: Gaseous Form
components: V, S, M (a bit of gauze)
description: A willing creature you touch, with its gear, becomes a misty cloud. Its only movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet (it can hover); it can enter other creatures' spaces and pass through narrow openings. It has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, Immunity to Prone, and Advantage on STR, DEX, and CON saves. It can't talk, manipulate objects, attack, or cast spells. The spell ends if it drops to 0 Hit Points or takes a Magic action to end it.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 3.

name: Glyph of Warding
components: V, S, M (powdered diamond worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Inscribe a nearly invisible glyph on a surface or inside a closable object, with a trigger you define. If the object is moved more than 10 feet, the glyph breaks. When triggered, the glyph releases one of the effects below.

subEntries.label: Explosive Runes
subEntries.text: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (chosen at creation) on a failure, or half on success.

subEntries.label: Spell Glyph
subEntries.text: Store a prepared spell of level 3 or lower that targets a creature or area; it is cast at the triggering creature or centered on it when the glyph activates.

higherLevel: Explosive Runes damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3, and a Spell Glyph can store a spell up to the slot's level.

name: Haste
components: V, S, M (a shaving of licorice root)
description: One willing creature's Speed doubles, it gains +2 AC, Advantage on Dexterity saves, and an additional action each turn, usable only for Attack (one attack), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize. When the spell ends, the target has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0 until the end of its next turn.

name: Hunger of Hadar
description: You open a gateway to the Far Realm, creating a 20-foot-radius Sphere of Darkness that is Difficult Terrain. No light can illuminate it, and creatures fully inside have the Blinded condition. A creature that starts its turn there takes 2d6 Cold damage. A creature that ends its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 2d6 Acid damage from otherworldly tentacles.
higherLevel: Cold or Acid damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
description: A twisting pattern of colors appears in a 30-foot Cube. Each creature in the area that can see it makes a Wisdom save or has the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, it has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0. The spell ends for a creature if it takes any damage or someone else uses an action to shake it out of its stupor.

name: Intellect Fortress
description: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to Psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
higherLevel: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
description: A stationary 10-foot Emanation springs up around you; the spell fails if it can't fully contain all creatures in its area. Creatures and objects inside at casting can pass freely; all others are barred. Spells of level 3 or lower can't be cast through it or extend into it. The interior stays comfortable and dry, with Dim Light or Darkness as you choose; it is opaque from outside. The spell ends early if you leave it or cast it again.

name: Life Transference
description: You sacrifice some of your health to mend another creature's injuries. You take 4d8 Necrotic damage, and one creature of your choice that you can see within range regains a number of Hit Points equal to twice the Necrotic damage you take. The damage to you can't be reduced or prevented in any way.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Lightning Arrow
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting or missing a target with a ranged attack using a weapon
description: Your weapon or ammunition turns into a lightning bolt. Instead of the attack's normal damage and effects, the target takes 4d8 Lightning damage on a hit, or half as much on a miss. Each creature within 10 feet of the target then makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. The weapon or ammunition then returns to normal.
higherLevel: Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Lightning Bolt
components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a crystal rod)
description: A 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide bolt of lightning blasts from you. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save: 8d6 Lightning on a fail, half on success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Magic Circle
components: V, S, M (salt and powdered silver worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall Cylinder warding against one or more of Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. Such creatures can't willingly enter it by nonmagical means (teleporting in requires a Charisma save), have Disadvantage on attacks against targets inside, and can't charm, frighten, or possess anyone inside. You can reverse the circle to trap such creatures inside instead.
higherLevel: Duration increases by 1 hour per slot level above 3.

name: Major Image
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
description: Create an illusion of an object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 20-foot Cube, complete with sound, smell, and temperature (but it can't deal damage). As a Magic action you can make it move and act naturally. Physical interaction reveals it as an illusion; a creature can take a Study action and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it.
higherLevel: With a level 4+ slot, the spell lasts until dispelled without requiring Concentration.

name: Mass Healing Word
description: Up to six creatures you can see within range each regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevel: Healing increases by 1d4 per slot level above 3.

name: Meld into Stone
description: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to contain you, along with your gear. You can't see outside and have Disadvantage on Perception checks to hear, but you can cast spells on yourself; use 5 feet of movement to leave where you entered, ending the spell. Partial destruction or reshaping of the stone expels you with 6d6 Force damage; complete destruction expels you with 50 Force damage. If expelled, you have the Prone condition.

name: Melf's Minute Meteors
components: V, S, M (niter, sulfur, and pine tar formed into a bead)
description: You create six tiny meteors in your space. They float in the air and orbit you for the spell's duration. When you cast the spell—and as a Bonus Action on each of your turns thereafter—you can expend one or two of the meteors, sending them streaking toward one or two points you choose within 120 feet of you. Once a meteor reaches its destination or impacts a solid surface, it explodes. Each creature within 5 feet of the point where the meteor explodes must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 2d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
higherLevel: The number of meteors created increases by two for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Nondetection
components: V, S, M (a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A touched willing creature, place, or object (up to 10 feet in any dimension) can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Phantom Steed
description: A Large, quasi-real, horselike creature appears with a saddle, bit, and bridle. It uses Riding Horse statistics but has a Speed of 100 feet and can travel 13 miles in an hour. The spell ends early if the steed takes any damage. When the spell ends, the steed fades over 1 minute, giving the rider time to dismount.

name: Plant Growth
description: Channel vitality into plants within range, with one of the effects below depending on the casting time.

subEntries.label: Overgrowth (Magic Action)
subEntries.text: Plants in a 100-foot-radius Sphere become thick and overgrown; a creature moving through them spends 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. You can exclude areas of any size.

subEntries.label: Enrichment (8 hours)
subEntries.text: Plants in a half-mile radius are enriched for 365 days, yielding twice the normal amount of food when harvested.

name: Protection from Energy
description: A willing creature you touch gains Resistance to one damage type of your choice — Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder — for the duration.

name: Remove Curse
description: All curses affecting one creature or object you touch end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement so the item can be removed or discarded.

name: Revivify
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a creature that died within the last minute. It returns to life with 1 Hit Point. Can't restore a creature that died of old age or one missing body parts.

name: Sending
description: Send up to 25 words to a familiar creature. It hears the message in its mind and can reply immediately. If on a different plane, 5% chance the message doesn't arrive.

name: Sleet Storm
description: Freezing rain and sleet fill a 40-foot-tall, 20-foot-radius Cylinder, which is Heavily Obscured and Difficult Terrain; exposed flames are doused. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity save or fall Prone and lose Concentration.

name: Slow
components: V, S, M (a drop of molasses)
description: Up to six creatures in a 40-foot Cube make a Wisdom save. Affected: Speed halved, −2 penalty to AC and DEX saves, no Reactions. On its turn it can take an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and makes only one attack with the Attack action. Spells with a Somatic component have a 25% chance to fail. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Speak with Dead
description: Grant the semblance of life to a corpse that has a mouth and isn't Undead, letting it answer up to five questions. It knows only what it knew in life, isn't compelled to be truthful, and answers briefly or cryptically. The spell fails if used on the same corpse within the last 10 days.

name: Speak with Plants
description: Plants within a 30-foot Emanation gain limited sentience, letting you communicate with them and give simple commands. They can tell you about events in the area in the past day, and you can have them turn Difficult Terrain caused by plant growth into ordinary terrain, or vice versa.

name: Spirit Guardians
description: Spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation; you can designate creatures to be unaffected. Other creatures have their Speed halved in it. Whenever the Emanation enters a creature's space, or a creature enters it or ends its turn there, it makes a Wisdom save: 3d8 Radiant (Necrotic if you are evil) damage on a fail, half on success. Once per turn per creature.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Spirit Shroud
description: You call forth spirits of the dead, which flit around you for the spell's duration. The spirits are intangible and invulnerable. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals 1d8 extra damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you. This damage is Radiant, Necrotic, or Cold (your choice when you cast the spell). Any creature that takes this damage can't regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. In addition, any creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d8 for every two spell levels above 3rd (2d8 at 5th and 6th, 3d8 at 7th and 8th, 4d8 at 9th).

name: Stinking Cloud
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of nauseating gas fills the area, which is Heavily Obscured. Each creature that starts its turn in it must succeed on a Constitution save or be Poisoned until the end of the current turn; while Poisoned this way it can't take an action or Bonus Action. A strong wind disperses the cloud.

name: Summon Fey
components: V, S, M (a gilded flower worth 300+ GP)
description: Summon a Fey spirit using the Fey Spirit stat block, choosing a Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy mood. It is an ally to you, shares your Initiative and acts right after you, and obeys your commands (otherwise it takes the Dodge action). It disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends.
higherLevel: Use the slot level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Summon Undead
components: V, S, M (a gilded skull worth 300+ GP)
description: Summon an Undead spirit using the Undead Spirit stat block, choosing a Ghostly, Putrid, or Skeletal form. It is an ally to you, shares your Initiative and acts right after you, and obeys your commands (otherwise it takes the Dodge action). It disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends.
higherLevel: Use the slot level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Thunder Step
description: You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within range. Immediately after you disappear, a thunderous boom sounds, and each creature within 10 feet of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d10 Thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The thunder can be heard from up to 300 feet away. You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also teleport one willing creature of your size or smaller who is within 5 feet of you, provided there is an unoccupied space within 5 feet of your destination for it to appear in.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Tidal Wave
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: You conjure up a wave of water that crashes down on an area within range. The area can be up to 30 feet long, up to 10 feet wide, and up to 10 feet tall. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. The water then spreads out across the ground in the area of the wave, extinguishing unprotected flames, and vanishes 1 minute later.

name: Tiny Servant
description: You touch one Tiny, nonmagical object that isn't attached to another object or a surface and isn't being carried by another creature. The target animates and sprouts little arms and legs, becoming a creature under your control until the spell ends or it drops to 0 Hit Points. As a Bonus Action, you can mentally command the creature if it is within 120 feet of you, directing what action it will take and where it will move on its next turn. It follows your commands, defending itself against hostile creatures if given no other commands. When the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it reverts to its original form, and any remaining damage carries over to that form.
higherLevel: You can animate two additional objects for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Tongues
description: The touched creature understands any spoken language it hears. When it speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear it understands what it says.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt. Until the spell ends, you can make the attack again on each of your turns as a Magic action.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Wall of Water
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: You conjure up a wall of water on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall's space is difficult terrain. Any ranged weapon attack that enters the wall's space has disadvantage on the attack roll, and Fire damage is halved if the fire effect passes through the wall. Spells that deal Cold damage that pass through the wall cause the area of the wall they pass through to freeze solid. Each frozen section (at least a 5-foot square) has AC 5 and 15 Hit Points; reducing a frozen section to 0 Hit Points destroys it without filling the gap.

name: Water Breathing
description: Up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range can breathe underwater until the spell ends. They also retain their normal mode of respiration.

name: Water Walk
components: V, S, M (a piece of cork)
description: Up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range can move across any liquid surface — water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava — as if it were harmless solid ground (molten lava's heat can still damage them). A target must take a Bonus Action to pass from the surface into the liquid or vice versa; if it falls into the liquid, it passes through the surface.

name: Wind Wall
components: V, S, M (a fan and a feather)
description: A wall of strong wind up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick rises from the ground. Each creature in its area when it appears makes a Strength save, taking 4d8 Bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on success. The wind keeps fog, smoke, and gases away, blocks Small or smaller flying creatures and objects, and causes arrows, bolts, and other ordinary ammunition to miss.

name: Arcane Eye
components: V, S, M (a bit of bat fur)
description: You create an Invisible, invulnerable magical eye that hovers within range and has Darkvision out to 30 feet. You receive its visual information and can look in every direction through it. As a Bonus Action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction; it can't pass through solid barriers but can squeeze through openings 1 inch across.

name: Aura of Life
description: A 30-foot Emanation of life energy surrounds you. You and your allies in it have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and their Hit Point maximums can't be reduced. An ally in the aura with 0 Hit Points regains 1 Hit Point when it starts its turn there.

name: Aura of Purity
description: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation. While in it, you and your allies have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end effects that include the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition.

name: Banishment
description: One creature you can see makes a Charisma save or is transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration, where it has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space. If the target is an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend and the spell lasts the full 1 minute, it doesn't return; it's sent to a random location on a plane associated with its creature type.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 4.

name: Blight
description: Necromantic energy drains a creature you can see. It makes a Constitution save: 8d8 Necrotic damage on a fail, half on success. A Plant creature automatically fails. Alternatively, target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or shrub; it withers and dies (no save).
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Charm Monster
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw (with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it). On a failure, it is Charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you, and it knows it was charmed when the spell ends.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 4.

name: Compulsion
description: Each creature of your choice you can see within range makes a Wisdom save or has the Charmed condition for the duration. As a Bonus Action, you can designate a horizontal direction; each Charmed target must use as much of its movement as possible to move that way on its next turn, taking the safest route. After moving this way, a target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

name: Confusion
description: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save. On a failure, it can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions and rolls 1d10 at the start of each of its turns: 1, no action and uses all its movement in a random direction (1d4); 2-6, doesn't move or take actions; 7-8, makes one melee attack against a random creature within reach (or does nothing); 9-10, chooses its behavior. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
higherLevel: Radius increases by 5 feet per slot level above 4.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
description: You summon spirits from the Elemental Planes that flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals an extra 2d8 damage when you hit a creature in the Emanation, of a type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning. The ground in the Emanation is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.
higherLevel: Extra damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
description: Nature spirits flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see, or a creature you can see enters it or ends its turn there, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw: 5d8 Force damage on a failure, half on a success. A creature makes this save only once per turn. You can also take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action for the duration.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Control Water
components: V, S, M (a mixture of water and dust)
description: You control any water inside a Cube up to 100 feet on a side within range, choosing one of the effects below. As a Magic action on later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

subEntries.label: Flood
subEntries.text: Standing water in the area rises up to 20 feet. In a large body of water, this instead creates a 20-foot wave that crosses the area, carrying Huge or smaller vehicles and giving each one struck a 25 percent chance of capsizing; the wave repeats at the start of your next turn while the flood lasts.

subEntries.label: Part Water
subEntries.text: The water parts to create a trench through the area, with walls of water on either side. When the effect ends, the trench slowly refills over the next round.

subEntries.label: Redirect Flow
subEntries.text: Flowing water in the area moves in a direction you choose, even over obstacles or up walls. It resumes its normal flow once it leaves the area.

subEntries.label: Whirlpool
subEntries.text: Requires an area at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. Creatures in the water within 25 feet of the whirlpool are pulled 10 feet toward it. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there makes a Strength save: 2d8 Bludgeoning damage on a fail, half on success. Swimming away takes an action and a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.

name: Death Ward
description: You touch a creature. The first time it would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, it instead drops to 1 Hit Point and the spell ends. If it is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against it and the spell ends.

name: Dimension Door
description: You teleport to a spot within range that you can see, visualize, or describe by distance and direction (such as 200 feet straight downward). You can also teleport one willing creature within 5 feet of you; it arrives within 5 feet of your destination. If either of you would arrive in an occupied space, each of you takes 4d6 Force damage and the teleportation fails.

name: Divination
components: V, S, M (incense worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You contact a god or a god's servant and ask one question about a specific goal, event, or activity occurring within 7 days. The DM gives a truthful reply, which might be a short phrase, cryptic rhyme, or omen. If you cast the spell more than once before a Long Rest, each casting after the first has a cumulative 25 percent chance of giving no answer.

name: Dominate Beast
description: One Beast you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw (with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it) or is Charmed for the duration. You have a telepathic link with it and can issue commands on your turn (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can take a Reaction to have it use its Reaction. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevel: Duration: 10 minutes (5), 1 hour (6), 8 hours (7+), still Concentration.

name: Elemental Bane
description: Choose one creature you can see within range, and choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the spell for its duration. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra 2d6 damage of that type. Moreover, the target loses any resistance to that damage type until the spell ends.
higherLevel: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
description: Writhing tentacles fill a 20-foot square on the ground, making it Difficult Terrain. Each creature in the area makes a Strength save; on a failure, it takes 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A creature also makes this save when it enters the area or ends its turn there, but only once per turn. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 4.

name: Fabricate
description: You convert raw materials into products of the same material, such as a bridge from a clump of trees or clothes from flax. You can fabricate a Large or smaller object contained in a 10-foot Cube (or eight connected 5-foot Cubes), but a metal, stone, or other mineral object can be no larger than Medium (a 5-foot Cube). Quality depends on the materials. You can't create creatures or magic items, and items needing high skill, such as weapons and armor, require proficiency with the matching Artisan's Tools.

name: Find Greater Steed
description: You summon a spirit that takes the form of a loyal, majestic mount. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the spirit takes the form you choose: a griffon, a pegasus, a peryton, a dire wolf, a rhinoceros, or a saber-toothed tiger. The creature has the statistics for the chosen form, though it is a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice) instead of its normal creature type. If it has an Intelligence of 5 or lower, its Intelligence becomes 6, and it gains the ability to understand one language of your choice. You control the mount in combat. While mounted on it, you can make any spell you cast that targets only you also target the mount. The mount disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when you dismiss it as an action. Casting this spell again resummons the bonded mount, fully healed.

name: Fire Shield
components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or a firefly)
description: Wispy flames wreathe your body, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. Choose a warm or chill shield; whenever a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack roll, it takes 2d8 damage from the shield.

subEntries.label: Warm Shield
subEntries.text: You have Resistance to Cold damage, and attackers take Fire damage.

subEntries.label: Chill Shield
subEntries.text: You have Resistance to Fire damage, and attackers take Cold damage.

name: Fount of Moonlight
description: Cool light wreathes you, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. You have Resistance to Radiant damage, and your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 Radiant damage on a hit. Immediately after you take damage from a creature you can see within 60 feet, you can take a Reaction to force it to make a Constitution save; on a failure, it is Blinded until the end of your next turn.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: A willing creature you touch is unaffected by Difficult Terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce its Speed nor give it the Paralyzed or Restrained condition. It has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed, and it can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature Grappling it.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 4.

name: Giant Insect
description: You summon a giant centipede, spider, or wasp (your choice) that manifests in an unoccupied space within range and uses the Giant Insect stat block. It is an ally to you and your companions, shares your Initiative but acts immediately after you, and obeys your verbal commands. If you issue none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block (AC 11 + level; HP 30 + 10 per level above 4; attacks per Multiattack equal half the level).

name: Grasping Vine
description: You conjure a vine that sprouts from a surface within range. When you cast the spell, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of the vine. On a hit, the target takes 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and is pulled up to 30 feet toward the vine; if it is Huge or smaller, it is also Grappled (escape DC equals your spell save DC). The vine can grapple only one creature at a time and can release it (no action required).
higherLevel: The vine can grapple one additional creature per slot level above 4.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: You or a creature you touch has the Invisible condition for the duration. Unlike Invisibility, this spell doesn't end if the target attacks or casts a spell.

name: Guardian of Faith
description: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers in an unoccupied space you can see. Any enemy that moves to a space within 10 feet of it for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, makes a Dexterity saving throw: 20 Radiant damage on a failure, half on a success. The guardian vanishes after dealing a total of 60 damage.

name: Guardian of Nature
description: A nature spirit answers your call and transforms you into a powerful guardian. Choose one of the following forms. Primal Beast: Bestial fur covers your body. You gain darkvision (120 ft.), your walking speed increases by 10 feet, you make Strength-based attack rolls with advantage, and your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 Force damage on a hit. Great Tree: Your skin appears barky and leaves sprout from your hair. You gain 10 Temporary Hit Points, make Constitution saving throws with advantage, make Dexterity- and Wisdom-based attack rolls with advantage, and the ground within 15 feet of you is difficult terrain for enemies while you are on the ground.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
description: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot Cube look, sound, and smell like a different kind of natural terrain, such as making a road look like a swamp. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures aren't changed. Tactile features are unchanged, so creatures entering the area are likely to notice the illusion; otherwise, a creature can take the Study action and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to disbelieve it. A creature that discerns the illusion sees a vague image superimposed on the real terrain.

name: Ice Storm
description: Hail pounds a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder. Each creature makes a Dexterity save: 2d10 Bludgeoning + 4d6 Cold on a fail, half on success. The area becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

name: Leomund's Secret Chest
components: V, S, M (a chest, 3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet, constructed from rare materials worth 5,000+ GP, and a Tiny replica of the chest made from the same materials worth 50+ GP)
description: You hide a chest and its contents (up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material) on the Ethereal Plane. While it's there, you can take a Magic action and touch the replica to recall the chest to within 5 feet of you, and take a Magic action touching both to send it back. After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5 percent chance each day that the spell ends. The spell also ends if you cast it again or the replica is destroyed; a chest left on the Ethereal Plane stays there.

name: Locate Creature
components: V, S, M (fur from a bloodhound)
description: Describe or name a creature familiar to you. You sense the direction to it if it is within 1,000 feet, and if it's moving, you know the direction of its movement. You can locate a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind if you have seen one up close (within 30 feet) at least once. The spell fails on a creature in a different form (such as from Polymorph) or if any thickness of lead blocks the direct path.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
description: You conjure a phantom watchdog that only you can see; it is intangible and invulnerable and has Truesight 30 feet. It barks loudly when a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet without speaking your password. At the start of each of your turns, it bites one enemy within 5 feet: Dexterity save or take 4d8 Force damage. As a Magic action on later turns, you can move it up to 30 feet. The spell ends if you and the hound are more than 300 feet apart.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
components: V, S, M (a thin sheet of lead)
description: You make a Cube from 5 to 100 feet on a side magically secure, choosing any of these protections: sound can't pass the barrier; the barrier is dark and foggy, blocking vision (including Darkvision); Divination sensors can't appear inside or pass through; creatures inside can't be targeted by Divination spells; nothing can teleport into or out of the area; planar travel is blocked within it. Casting it on the same spot every day for 365 days makes it last until dispelled.
higherLevel: The Cube's size increases by 100 feet per slot level above 4.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
description: A shimmering sphere encloses a Large or smaller creature or object. An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity saving throw to avoid it. Nothing can pass through the sphere, and it is immune to all damage; a creature inside can breathe but can't damage or be damaged by anything outside. An enclosed creature can take an action to roll the sphere at up to half its Speed, and others can pick the weightless sphere up. Disintegrate destroys the sphere without harming its contents.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: You draw on the nightmares of a creature you can see. It makes a Wisdom saving throw: on a failure it takes 4d10 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls for the duration; on a success it takes half damage and the spell ends. A failed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, taking 4d10 Psychic damage on a failure and ending the spell on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

name: Polymorph
description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or shape-shifts into a Beast with a Challenge Rating equal to or less than its own (or its level). Its game statistics are replaced by the Beast's, but it keeps its alignment, personality, creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice, and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast's Hit Points. The spell ends early if it has no Temporary Hit Points left, and any left over vanish when the spell ends. It can't speak or cast spells, its actions are limited by its new anatomy, and its gear melds into the new form.

name: Shadow of Moil
components: V, S, M (an undead eyeball encased in a gem worth at least 150+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Flame-like shadows wreathe your body until the spell ends, causing you to become heavily obscured to others. The shadows turn dim light within 10 feet of you into darkness, and bright light in the same area to dim light. Until the spell ends, you have resistance to Radiant damage. In addition, whenever a creature within 10 feet of you hits you with an attack, the shadows lash out at that creature, dealing it 2d8 Necrotic damage.

name: Sickening Radiance
description: Dim, greenish light spreads within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The light spreads around corners and lasts until the spell ends. When a creature moves into the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 Radiant damage, suffer one level of exhaustion, and emit a dim greenish light in a 5-foot radius (making invisibility ineffective). These effects go away when the spell ends.

name: Staggering Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The target takes an extra 4d6 Psychic damage from the attack and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: Extra damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 4.

name: Stone Shape
description: You touch a stone object (Medium or smaller, or a section up to 5 feet in any dimension) and shape it into any form you choose, such as a weapon, statue, coffer, a passage through a wall 5 feet thick, or a sealed door. The object can have up to two hinges and a latch, but no finer mechanical detail.

name: Stoneskin
components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

name: Storm Sphere
description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of whirling air springs into existence centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the sphere when it appears or that ends its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage. The sphere's space is difficult terrain. Until the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action on each of your turns to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the center toward one creature you choose within 60 feet of the center. Make a ranged spell attack (advantage if target is in the sphere). On a hit, the target takes 4d6 Lightning damage.
higherLevel: The bludgeoning damage and the lightning damage each increase by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Summon Aberration
components: V, S, M (a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
description: You call forth an aberrant spirit (Beholderkin, Mind Flayer, or Slaad form) that appears in an unoccupied space and uses the Aberrant Spirit stat block. It is an ally that shares your Initiative, acts immediately after you, and obeys your verbal commands; without commands it takes the Dodge action.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the stat block's level-dependent values.

name: Summon Construct
components: V, S, M (a lockbox worth 400+ GP)
description: You call forth the spirit of a Construct (Clay, Metal, or Stone form) that appears in an unoccupied space and uses the Construct Spirit stat block. It is an ally that shares your Initiative, acts immediately after you, and obeys your verbal commands; without commands it takes the Dodge action.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the stat block's level-dependent values.

name: Summon Elemental
components: V, S, M (air, a pebble, ash, and water inside a gold-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
description: You call forth an Elemental spirit (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water form) that appears in an unoccupied space and uses the Elemental Spirit stat block. It is an ally that shares your Initiative, acts immediately after you, and obeys your verbal commands; without commands it takes the Dodge action.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the stat block's level-dependent values.

name: Summon Greater Demon
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a Humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
description: You utter foul words, summoning one demon of challenge rating 5 or lower (such as a shadow demon or barlgura) from the Abyss. The demon appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. Roll initiative for the demon. You can verbally command it each turn (no action required), but it makes a Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns; on a success your control ends. An uncontrolled demon doesn't disappear for 1d6 rounds after the spell ends. As part of casting, you can form a 5-foot-radius magic circle on the ground. While the demon is within the circle, it can't target anyone inside with attacks or spells.
higherLevel: The challenge rating of the demon you can summon increases by 1 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
components: V, S, M (a drop of bile)
description: A ball of acid explodes at a point within range in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature there makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10d4 Acid damage plus another 5d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half the initial damage only.
higherLevel: Initial damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 4.

name: Wall of Fire
components: V, S, M (a piece of charcoal)
description: Create an opaque wall of fire on a solid surface, up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. Each creature in its area when it appears makes a Dexterity save: 5d8 Fire damage on a fail, half on success. One side of the wall (your choice) deals 5d8 Fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall, or that enters the wall for the first time on a turn. The other side deals no damage.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Watery Sphere
components: V, S, M (a droplet of water)
description: You conjure up a sphere of water with a 10-foot radius at a point you can see within range, hovering no more than 10 feet off the ground. Any creature in the sphere's space must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is Restrained and engulfed; on a success, it is ejected to the nearest unoccupied space. A Huge or larger creature automatically succeeds; a Large or smaller creature can choose to fail. A Restrained creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. The sphere can Restrain up to four Medium or smaller creatures or one Large creature. As an action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet in a straight line, pushing Restrained creatures with it, and you can ram it into creatures along the way. When the spell ends, the sphere falls, knocking creatures prone, and the water vanishes.

name: Animate Objects
description: Choose nonmagical objects within range that aren't worn, carried, fixed to a surface, or Gargantuan, up to a number equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (Medium or smaller counts as one, Large as two, Huge as three). Each becomes a Construct ally using the Animated Object stat block, sharing your Initiative and acting right after you. As a Bonus Action, you can command any of them within 500 feet (the same command to each); otherwise they take the Dodge action. At 0 Hit Points, a creature reverts to its object form, and excess damage carries over.
higherLevel: Slam damage increases by 1d4 (Medium or smaller), 1d6 (Large), or 1d12 (Huge) per slot level above 5.

name: Antilife Shell
description: A 10-foot Emanation surrounds you that creatures other than Constructs and Undead can't pass into or reach through. An affected creature can still cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through the barrier. The aura moves with you, but if you move so that an affected creature is forced through it, the spell ends.

name: Awaken
components: V, S, M (an agate worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a Beast or Plant creature with an Intelligence of 3 or less, or a natural plant that isn't a creature. It gains an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. A natural plant becomes a Plant creature that can move its limbs and gains senses similar to a human's. The target has the Charmed condition for 30 days or until you or your allies deal damage to it; then it chooses its attitude toward you.

name: Banishing Smite
castTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The target takes an extra 5d10 Force damage from the attack. If the attack leaves it with 50 Hit Points or fewer, it must succeed on a Charisma save or be banished to a harmless demiplane, where it is Incapacitated until the spell ends, after which it reappears where it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Bigby's Hand
components: V, S, M (an eggshell and a glove)
description: You create a Large hand of force (AC 20, HP equal to your Hit Point maximum) in an unoccupied space; the spell ends if it drops to 0 Hit Points. When you cast it and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and use one of its effects.

subEntries.label: Clenched Fist
subEntries.text: Make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of the hand. On a hit, it takes 5d8 Force damage.

subEntries.label: Forceful Hand
subEntries.text: A Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of the hand makes a Strength save or is pushed up to 5 feet plus five times your spellcasting ability modifier in feet. The hand moves with it, staying within 5 feet.

subEntries.label: Grasping Hand
subEntries.text: A Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of the hand makes a Dexterity save or has the Grappled condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC). While it's grappled, you can take a Bonus Action to crush it for 4d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier Bludgeoning damage.

subEntries.label: Interposing Hand
subEntries.text: The hand grants you Half Cover against attacks and other effects that originate from its space or pass through it, and its space is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.

higherLevel: Clenched Fist damage increases by 2d8 and Grasping Hand damage by 2d6 per slot level above 5.

name: Circle of Power
description: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation. You and your allies in it have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and when they succeed on a save that halves damage, they take no damage instead.

name: Cloudkill
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of poisonous fog appears, Heavily Obscuring its area. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save: 5d8 Poison damage on a fail, half on success. A creature also makes this save when the Sphere moves into its space, when it enters the Sphere, or when it ends its turn there (once per turn). The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns. Strong wind disperses it, ending the spell.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Commune
description: You contact a deity or divine proxy and ask up to three questions answerable with yes or no. You receive correct answers, though they may be "unclear" if the answer is beyond the being's knowledge. Each additional casting before a Long Rest has a cumulative 25% chance of getting no answer.

name: Commune with Nature
description: You learn about the area within 3 miles of you outdoors, or 300 feet in caves and other natural underground settings; the spell doesn't work where construction has replaced nature, such as castles and settlements. Choose three facts to learn: locations of settlements; locations of portals to other planes; the location of one CR 10+ Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead (GM's choice); the most prevalent kind of plant, mineral, or Beast; or locations of bodies of water.

name: Cone of Cold
components: V, S, M (a small crystal or glass cone)
description: Each creature in a 60-foot Cone makes a Constitution save: 8d8 Cold on a fail, half on success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Conjure Elemental
description: You conjure a Large, intangible elemental spirit in an unoccupied space. Its element sets its damage type: air (Lightning), earth (Thunder), fire (Fire), or water (Cold). If the spirit has no creature Restrained, when a creature you can see enters its space or starts its turn within 5 feet of it, you can force a Dexterity save: on a failure, the target takes 8d8 damage and is Restrained until the spell ends. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target repeats the save, taking 4d8 damage on a failure and escaping on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Conjure Volley
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: You brandish your weapon and a volley of spectral copies rains down on a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point in range. Each creature of your choice that you can see in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Contact Other Plane
description: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or another knowledgeable entity. Make a DC 15 Intelligence save: on a failure, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and are Incapacitated until you finish a Long Rest. On a success, you can ask up to five questions, receiving one-word answers.

name: Contagion
description: The target makes a Constitution save or takes 11d8 Necrotic damage and is Poisoned. Choose an ability; while Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saves with it. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns until it has three successes (spell ends) or three failures (the spell lasts 7 days). Whenever an effect would end its Poisoned condition, it must succeed on a Constitution save or the condition doesn't end.

name: Control Winds
description: You take control of the air in a 100-foot cube that you can see within range. Choose one of the following effects when you cast the spell; you can switch effects or halt/restart with your action on later turns. Gusts: A horizontal wind of your chosen intensity (calm, moderate, or strong) blows through the cube. Moderate or strong wind gives ranged weapon attacks disadvantage if passing through the cube; strong wind costs 1 extra foot of movement per foot moved against it. Downdraft: A strong downward blast gives ranged weapon attacks disadvantage. Creatures flying into or starting their turn flying in the cube must make a Strength save or be knocked prone. Updraft: A sustained updraft halves fall damage for creatures landing in the cube, and creatures can jump twice the normal distance within it.

name: Creation
description: You create a nonliving object of vegetable or mineral matter fitting in a 5-foot Cube. Its duration depends on the material: vegetable matter lasts 24 hours, stone or crystal 12 hours, precious metals 1 hour, gems 10 minutes, and adamantine or mithral 1 minute. Using it as a material component causes the spell to fail.
higherLevel: The Cube's size increases by 5 feet per slot level above 5.

name: Danse Macabre
description: Threads of dark power leap from your fingers to pierce up to five Small or Medium corpses you can see within range. Each corpse immediately stands up and becomes Undead. You decide whether it is a zombie or a skeleton, and it gains a bonus to its attack and damage rolls equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. As a Bonus Action, you can mentally command the creatures you made with this spell (all receiving the same command) if they are within 60 feet of you. Each creature remains under your control until it drops to 0 Hit Points. When the spell ends, all creatures you created with this spell immediately fall down and are no longer Undead.
higherLevel: You can animate two additional corpses for each slot level above 5th.

name: Dawn
components: V, S, M (a sunburst pendant worth at least 100+ GP)
description: The light of dawn shines down on a location you specify within range. Until the spell ends, a 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of bright sunlight glimmers there. When the cylinder appears, each creature in it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw whenever it ends its turn in the cylinder. If you're within 5 feet of the cylinder, you can move it up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action on your turn.

name: Destructive Wave
description: Destructive energy ripples out in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature you choose in it makes a Constitution save: on a failure, it takes 5d6 Thunder damage plus 5d6 Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice) and is knocked Prone; on a success, half damage only.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
components: V, S, M (powdered silver and iron)
description: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you while the spell lasts. You can end the spell early to use one of its special functions.

subEntries.label: Break Enchantment
subEntries.text: As a Magic action, touch a creature that is possessed by, or Charmed or Frightened by, one or more creatures of those types. It is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by them.

subEntries.label: Dismissal
subEntries.text: As a Magic action, target one creature of those types you can see within 5 feet. It makes a Charisma save or is sent back to its home plane; if not on their home planes, Undead go to the Shadowfell and Fey to the Feywild.

name: Dominate Person
description: One Humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save (with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it) or has the Charmed condition for the duration. While on the same plane, you have a telepathic link and can issue commands on your turn (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can take your Reaction to have it take a Reaction. Each time it takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevel: Duration: up to 10 minutes (level 6), 1 hour (7), 8 hours (8+), still Concentration.

name: Dream
components: V, S, M (a handful of sand)
description: You target a creature you know on the same plane. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance (Incapacitated, Speed 0) as a dream messenger. If the target is asleep, or once it falls asleep, the messenger enters its dreams and can converse with it and shape the dream; the target recalls the dream perfectly. The messenger can instead be terrifying, delivering a message of up to ten words: the target makes a Wisdom save or gains no benefit from its rest and takes 3d6 Psychic damage on waking.

name: Enervation
description: A tendril of inky darkness reaches out from you, touching a creature you can see within range to drain life from it. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, it takes 2d8 Necrotic damage and the spell ends. On a failed save, it takes 4d8 Necrotic damage, and until the spell ends you can automatically deal 4d8 Necrotic damage to the target by using your action (the spell ends if you use your action to do anything else, or if the target is ever outside the spell's range or has total cover from you). Whenever the spell deals damage to a target, you regain Hit Points equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage the target takes.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Far Step
description: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. On each of your turns before the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport in this way again.

name: Flame Strike
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur)
description: A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d6 Fire and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: Fire and Radiant damage each increase by 1d6 per slot level above 5.

name: Geas
description: You give a verbal command to a creature you can see to carry out a service or refrain from an action. It makes a Wisdom save (automatically succeeding if it can't understand you) or has the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage (no more than once per day) whenever it acts directly counter to your command. A suicidal command ends the spell, as does Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish.
higherLevel: Duration is 365 days with a level 7 or 8 slot, or until ended by Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish with a level 9 slot.

name: Greater Restoration
components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a creature and remove one effect: 1 Exhaustion level; the Charmed or Petrified condition; a curse, including Attunement to a cursed magic item; any reduction to one ability score; or any reduction to its Hit Point maximum.

name: Hallow
components: V, S, M (incense worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a point and infuse an area up to a 60-foot radius with holy or unholy power (it fails if it includes another Hallow's area). Choose any of Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead: those creatures can't willingly enter, and creatures in the area aren't possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by them. You also bind one extra effect: Courage, Darkness, Daylight, Peaceful Rest, Extradimensional Interference, Fear, Resistance, Silence, Tongues, or Vulnerability.

name: Hold Monster
components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or has the Paralyzed condition for the duration. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
higherLevel: Target one additional creature per slot level above 5.

name: Holy Weapon
description: You imbue a weapon you touch with holy power. Until the spell ends, the weapon emits bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet, and weapon attacks made with it deal an extra 2d8 Radiant damage on a hit. If the weapon isn't already a magic weapon, it becomes one for the duration. As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can dismiss this spell and cause the weapon to emit a burst of radiance. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the weapon must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 Radiant damage and is Blinded for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half damage and isn't Blinded. A Blinded creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Immovable Object
components: V, S, M (gold dust worth at least 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch an object that weighs no more than 10 pounds and cause it to become magically fixed in place. You and creatures you designate when you cast the spell can move the object normally. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, suppresses this spell for 1 minute. If the object is fixed in the air, it can hold up to 4,000 pounds of weight; more weight causes the object to fall. Otherwise, a creature can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the creature can move the object up to 10 feet.
higherLevel: The weight limit doubles for each slot level above 5th.

name: Infernal Calling
components: V, S, M (a ruby worth at least 999+ GP)
description: You summon a devil of challenge rating 6 or lower from the Nine Hells. The devil appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range and is unfriendly toward you and your companions. Roll initiative for the devil. You can try to verbally command it (no action required), but it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw to obey. The devil makes this saving throw at the end of each of its turns; on a success, your control ends. If you possess the devil's true name, it has disadvantage on this save. When concentration ends before the spell's full duration, an uncontrolled devil doesn't necessarily disappear; it may barter with or attack you based on how you've treated it.
higherLevel: The challenge rating of the devil you can summon increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Insect Plague
description: Swarming locusts fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere, which is Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain. A creature in it when it appears, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 4d10 Piercing damage on a failure or half on a success (once per turn).
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
components: V, S, M (a pinch of phosphorus)
description: A storm of flashing light and thunder fills a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder. Creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't cast spells with a Verbal component. Each creature in it when the storm appears, or that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, makes a Constitution save (once per turn), taking 2d10 Radiant and 2d10 Thunder damage on a failure or half on a success.
higherLevel: Radiant and Thunder damage each increase by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

name: Legend Lore
components: V, S, M (incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each)
description: Name or describe a person, place, or object. The spell brings to mind a brief summary of significant lore about that subject. If the subject isn't of legendary importance, you gain no information.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: Up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose each regain 5d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier in Hit Points.
higherLevel: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Mislead
description: You have the Invisible condition while an illusory double of you appears where you stand. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends right after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell. As a Magic action, you can move the intangible, invulnerable double up to twice your Speed and make it gesture, speak, and behave as you choose. You can see and hear through its eyes and ears as if you were where it is.

name: Modify Memory
description: The target makes a Wisdom save (with Advantage if you're fighting it) or has the Charmed and Incapacitated conditions, unaware of its surroundings but able to hear you. If it takes damage or is targeted by another spell, the spell ends with no memories changed. While Charmed, you can alter its memory of an event from the past 24 hours that lasted up to 10 minutes: eliminate it, recall it perfectly, change details, or invent another event. It must understand your language; the changes take hold when the spell ends. Remove Curse or Greater Restoration restores the true memory.
higherLevel: You can alter memories up to 7 days old (level 6), 30 days (level 7), 365 days (level 8), or any time in the creature's past (level 9).

name: Negative Energy Flood
components: V, M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
description: You send ribbons of negative energy at one creature you can see within range. Unless the target is Undead, it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d12 Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises up as a zombie at the start of your next turn, pursuing whatever creature it can see that is closest to it. If you target an Undead, the target doesn't make a saving throw; it gains temporary hit points equal to half the result of 5d12 instead.

name: Passwall
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sesame seeds)
description: A passage up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep appears in a wooden, plaster, or stone surface you can see. When the spell ends, creatures and objects still in the passage are safely ejected to the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Planar Binding
components: V, S, M (a jewel worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You attempt to bind a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend within range for the entire casting. It makes a Charisma save; on a failure, it must serve you for the duration, following your commands to the best of its ability.
higherLevel: Duration becomes 10 days (level 6), 30 days (level 7), 180 days (level 8), or 366 days (level 9).

name: Raise Dead
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a creature that has been dead no longer than 10 days and wasn't Undead when it died; it returns to life with 1 Hit Point. The spell neutralizes poisons and closes mortal wounds but doesn't restore missing body parts, and it fails if the creature lacks a part vital for survival, such as its head. The creature has a -4 penalty to D20 Tests, reduced by 1 each time it finishes a Long Rest.

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
description: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures within range. Until the spell ends, they can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance on the same plane, even without a shared language.

name: Reincarnate
components: V, S, M (rare oils worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a dead Humanoid or a piece of one that has been dead no longer than 10 days. A new body forms and the soul enters it; roll 1d10 for its species (Dragonborn, Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goliath, Halfling, Human, Orc, or Tiefling), or the GM chooses another playable species. The creature recalls its former life and keeps its capabilities, but loses its old species traits and gains the new ones.

name: Scrying
components: V, S, M (a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror, or water-filled font)
description: You can see and hear a creature you choose on the same plane. It makes a Wisdom save modified by how well you know it (+5 to -5) and your connection to it (likeness -2, possession -4, body part -10). On a success, it's unaffected and you can't scry it again for 24 hours. On a failure, an Invisible, intangible sensor appears within 10 feet of it and follows it; you see and hear through it as if you were there. Alternatively, you can target a location you have seen, where the sensor stays fixed.

name: Seeming
description: You give any number of creatures you can see an illusory new appearance, including clothing and gear. Unwilling targets can make a Charisma save to resist. The illusion fails against physical inspection, and a creature can take a Study action and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it.

name: Skill Empowerment
description: Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent. You touch one willing creature and give it Expertise in one skill of your choice. The skill you choose must be one that the target is already proficient in and that isn't already benefiting from an effect that doubles its proficiency bonus.

name: Steel Wind Strike
components: S, M (a Melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
description: You flourish your weapon and vanish to strike like the wind. Choose up to five creatures you can see in range and make a melee spell attack against each; on a hit, a target takes 6d10 Force damage. You then teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of one of the targets.

name: Summon Celestial
components: V, S, M (a reliquary worth 500+ GP)
description: You call forth a Celestial Spirit in Avenger or Defender form. It is an ally to you and your companions, acts immediately after you in combat, and obeys your verbal commands (no action required). Without commands, it takes the Dodge action and moves to avoid danger.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Summon Dragon
components: V, S, M (an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it worth 500+ GP)
description: You call forth a Dragon spirit using the Draconic Spirit stat block (AC 14 + spell level, HP 50 + 10 per level above 5, Fly 60 ft.). It is an ally, shares your Initiative but acts right after you, and obeys your verbal commands; otherwise it takes the Dodge action. It makes Rend attacks and uses a 30-foot Cone Breath Weapon (Dexterity save, 2d6 damage of a type it resists). Choose one of its Resistances (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison); you also have it until the spell ends.
higherLevel: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Swift Quiver
components: V, S, M (a Quiver worth 1+ GP)
description: When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you can make two attacks with a weapon that fires Arrows or Bolts. The spell magically creates the ammunition needed for each attack, which disintegrates after it hits or misses.

name: Synaptic Static
description: Psychic energy erupts in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in it makes an Intelligence save, taking 8d6 Psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. For 1 minute, a creature that failed subtracts 1d6 from attack rolls, ability checks, and Constitution saves to maintain Concentration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Telekinesis
description: When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on later turns, you affect one creature or object you can see within range. Creature: a Huge or smaller creature makes a Strength save or you move it up to 30 feet; it is Restrained until the end of your next turn, and if lifted, it falls then unless you affect it again. Object: you automatically move a Huge or smaller unattended object up to 30 feet; if it's worn or carried, the creature makes a Strength save or you pull it away. You can also exert fine control, such as manipulating a simple tool.

name: Teleportation Circle
components: V, M (rare inks worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You draw a 5-foot-radius circle on the ground linked to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know on the same plane. A shimmering portal opens until the end of your next turn, and any creature entering it appears within 5 feet of the destination circle. Casting it in the same spot daily for a year makes the circle permanent.

name: Transmute Rock
description: You choose an area of stone or mud up to 40 feet on a side within range and choose one of the following effects. Transmute Rock to Mud: Nonmagical rock becomes thick, flowing mud.
