Creatures in the area when rock becomes mud sink in and are Restrained; they can break free with a successful Strength check against your spell save DC. Creatures that start their turn Restrained must save again or sink deeper, becoming Restrained and Blinded. The mud remains until the spell ends. Transmute Mud to Rock: Mud (including Restrained creatures) becomes solid rock until the spell ends. Restrained creatures become Petrified until freed.

name: Tree Stride
description: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least your size. Using 5 feet of movement to enter, you can teleport once per turn and must end each turn outside a tree.

name: Wall of Force
components: V, S, M (a shard of glass)
description: An Invisible wall of force springs into existence in any orientation, free floating or resting on a surface: a dome or globe up to a 10-foot radius, or a flat surface of ten contiguous 10-by-10-foot panels, 1/4 inch thick. A creature in its space is pushed to one side (your choice). Nothing can physically pass through it, it is immune to all damage, and Dispel Magic can't end it, but Disintegrate destroys it instantly. It also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.

name: Wall of Light
description: A shimmering wall of bright light appears at a point you choose within range in any orientation. It can be up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight, but creatures and objects can pass through it. It emits bright light out to 120 feet and dim light for an additional 120 feet. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d8 Radiant damage and becoming Blinded for 1 minute on a failed save (half damage and not Blinded on a success). A Blinded creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. A creature that ends its turn in the wall's area takes 4d8 Radiant damage. You can also use your action to launch a beam of radiance at one creature within 60 feet; on a hit it takes 4d8 Radiant damage. Each beam reduces the wall's length by 10 feet; the spell ends when the wall length reaches 0.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Wall of Stone
components: V, S, M (a cube of granite)
description: A nonmagical stone wall appears, made of ten contiguous 10-foot-by-10-foot panels that are 6 inches thick (or 10-by-20-foot panels 3 inches thick); it must be supported by existing stone. A creature in its space is pushed to one side (your choice); a creature that would be fully enclosed can make a Dexterity save to use its Reaction to move up to its Speed out of the enclosure. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 HP per inch of thickness. If you maintain Concentration for the full duration, the wall becomes permanent.

name: Wrath of Nature
description: You call out to the spirits of nature to rouse them against your enemies. Choose a point you can see within range. Spirits cause trees, rocks, and grasses in a 60-foot cube centered on that point to become animated until the spell ends. Grasses: Any ground covered by grass or undergrowth in the cube is difficult terrain for your enemies. Trees: At the start of each of your turns, enemies within 10 feet of any tree in the cube must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 4d6 Slashing damage from whipping branches. Roots: At the end of each of your turns, one creature of your choice on the ground in the cube must succeed on a Strength save or become Restrained until the spell ends (or breaks free with a Strength check). Rocks: As a Bonus Action, cause a loose rock to launch at a creature you can see in the cube; make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 3d8 Bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a Strength save or fall prone.

name: Yolande's Regal Presence
description: You radiate regal majesty in a 10-foot Emanation. Whenever it enters the space of a creature you can see, or such a creature enters it or ends its turn there, you can force a Wisdom save (once per turn). On a failure, the creature takes 4d6 Psychic damage and has the Prone condition, and you can push it up to 10 feet away; on a success, half damage only.

name: Arcane Gate
description: You create two linked 10-foot-diameter teleportation portals: one in an unoccupied space you can see on the ground within range, and one within 10 feet of you. Anything entering one portal exits from the other. Each portal has a front and a back; only the front works. As a Bonus Action you can rotate the portals.

name: Blade Barrier
description: You create a wall of whirling blades up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ring up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall grants Three-Quarters Cover and its space is Difficult Terrain. A creature in the wall's space when it appears, or that enters it or ends its turn there, makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failure or half on a success (only once per turn).

name: Chain Lightning
description: A bolt of lightning strikes a target within range, then leaps to up to three other targets within 30 feet of the first. Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
higherLevel: One additional bolt leaps from the first target per slot level above 6.

name: Circle of Death
components: V, S, M (the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP)
description: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere centred on a point within range. Each creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 2d8 per slot level above 6.

name: Conjure Fey
description: You conjure a Medium fey spirit in an unoccupied space within range. When it appears, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you can teleport it up to 30 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 3d12 + your spellcasting modifier Psychic damage and is Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 6.

name: Contingency
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted statuette of yourself worth 1,500+ GP)
description: Choose a spell of level 5 or lower that you can cast, takes an action, and can target you. You cast it as part of this spell (expending both slots), but it takes effect only when a trigger you describe first occurs, whether or not you want it to, and then Contingency ends. The contingent spell affects only you. Only one Contingency can be active at a time, and it ends if the statuette isn't on your person.

name: Create Undead
components: V, S, M (one 150+ GP black onyx stone for each corpse)
description: Cast only at night. Up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range become Ghouls under your control. As a Bonus Action you can command any of them within 120 feet. Control lasts 24 hours; recast to reassert it before it lapses.
higherLevel: Level 7: four Ghouls. Level 8: five Ghouls or two Ghasts or Wights. Level 9: six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two Mummies.

name: Disintegrate
components: V, S, M (a lodestone and dust)
description: A green ray strikes a creature, nonmagical object, or creation of magical force you can see. A creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d6 + 40 Force damage on a failure (no damage on a success). If this reduces it to 0 HP, it and its nonmagical gear turn to dust; only True Resurrection or Wish can revive it. A Large or smaller nonmagical object or force creation is disintegrated automatically; if Huge or larger, a 10-foot Cube of it is.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 3d6 per slot level above 6.

name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
components: V, S, M (a sapphire worth 1,000+ GP)
description: You touch the sapphire and an object weighing 10 pounds or less, marking the object. Later, as a Magic Action, you can crush the sapphire to summon the object to your hand regardless of distance or plane. If another creature holds the object, you instead learn who holds it and roughly where.

name: Eyebite
description: Your eyes become inky voids. One creature you can see within 60 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or suffer one effect below for the duration. On each later turn you can take a Magic action to target another creature, but not one that already succeeded against this casting.

subEntries.label: Asleep
subEntries.text: The target has the Unconscious condition. It wakes if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it.

subEntries.label: Panicked
subEntries.text: The target is Frightened of you and must Dash away from you by the safest route on each of its turns, until it is 60 feet away and can't see you.

subEntries.label: Sickened
subEntries.text: The target has the Poisoned condition.

name: Find the Path
components: V, S, M (a set of divination tools, such as cards or runes, worth 100+ GP)
description: Name a specific fixed location familiar to you on the same plane. You always know the direction to it and the most direct physical route to reach it, including which path to take whenever there is a choice.

name: Flesh to Stone
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save. On a failure it is Restrained as its flesh hardens; on a success its Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. A Restrained target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the spell, three failures turn it to stone (Petrified). If you maintain Concentration for the full duration, the petrification lasts until removed.

name: Forbiddance
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,000+ GP)
description: You ward up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet. Creatures can't teleport into the area or enter it by planar travel. Choose Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and/or Undead: such creatures take 5d10 Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice) when they enter the area for the first time on a turn or end their turn there. You can designate a password to exempt creatures. Casting it on the same spot every day for 30 days makes it last until dispelled.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
description: An immobile, shimmering 10-foot-radius barrier surrounds you. Any spell of level 5 or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect anything within it, though such spells can be cast at targets inside without effect.
higherLevel: The barrier blocks spells of one level higher per slot level above 6.

name: Guards and Wards
components: V, S, M (a silver rod worth 10+ GP)
description: You ward up to 2,500 square feet of floor space with layered protections. You can designate individuals or a password to be unaffected. Casting it on the same area every day for a year makes it permanent.

subEntries.label: Corridors
subEntries.text: Fog fills warded corridors (Heavily Obscured). At each intersection, creatures have a 50% chance to go a direction other than the one they choose.

subEntries.label: Doors
subEntries.text: Warded doors are magically locked as by Arcane Lock, and you can cover up to ten of them with an illusion to look like plain wall.

subEntries.label: Stairs
subEntries.text: Webs fill warded stairs top to bottom, as the Web spell, regrowing within 10 minutes if destroyed.

subEntries.label: Other Spell Effect
subEntries.text: Add one of: Dancing Lights in four corridors, Magic Mouth in two locations, Stinking Cloud in two locations, a Gust of Wind in one corridor or room, or Suggestion in one 5-foot square.

name: Harm
description: You unleash virulent magic on a creature you can see. It makes a Constitution save, taking 14d6 Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. On a failure, its Hit Point maximum is also reduced by the Necrotic damage taken (to a minimum of 1).

name: Heal
description: One creature you can see regains 70 Hit Points and the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions are ended.
higherLevel: Healing increases by 10 per slot level above 6.

name: Heroes' Feast
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You conjure a feast that takes 1 hour to eat and serves up to twelve creatures. For 24 hours afterward, each diner has Resistance to Poison damage, is immune to the Frightened and Poisoned conditions, and has its Hit Point maximum increased by 2d10, gaining the same number of Hit Points.

name: Investiture of Flame
description: Flames race across your body, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. The flames don't harm you. Until the spell ends: you are immune to Fire damage and have resistance to Cold damage; any creature that moves within 5 feet of you for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 4d10 Fire damage; and you can use your action to create a 15-foot line of fire 5 feet wide—each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

name: Investiture of Ice
description: Ice rimes your body until the spell ends. You are immune to Cold damage and have resistance to Fire damage. You can move across difficult terrain created by ice or snow without spending extra movement. The ground in a 10-foot radius around you is icy difficult terrain for creatures other than you. You can use your action to create a 15-foot cone of freezing wind—each creature in the cone must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one, with speed halved until the start of your next turn on a failed save.

name: Investiture of Stone
description: Bits of rock spread across your body until the spell ends. You have resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. You can use your action to create a small earthquake on the ground in a 15-foot radius centered on you—other creatures on that ground must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. You can move across difficult terrain of earth or stone without extra movement cost and can move through solid earth or stone as if it were air (you can't end your movement there; if you do, you are ejected to the nearest unoccupied space and the spell ends).

name: Investiture of Wind
description: Wind whirls around you until the spell ends. Ranged weapon attacks made against you have disadvantage on the attack roll. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet. You can use your action to create a 15-foot cube of swirling wind centered on a point you can see within 60 feet of you. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 2d10 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one, and a Large or smaller creature that fails the save is pushed up to 10 feet away from the center of the cube.

name: Magic Jar
components: V, S, M (a gem, crystal, or reliquary worth 500+ GP)
description: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul enters the container. From the container you can attempt to possess a Humanoid within 100 feet (Charisma save), taking control of its body while its soul is trapped in the container. You can return to your body if it is within 100 feet. If the container is destroyed or the host body dies, consequences depend on where each soul is.

name: Mass Suggestion
description: You suggest a course of activity (25 words or fewer) to up to twelve creatures you can see that can hear and understand you. It must sound achievable and not obviously harm the targets or their allies. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Charmed for the duration or until you or your allies damage it, pursuing the suggestion as best it can. The spell ends for a target once it completes the activity.
higherLevel: Duration: 10 days (level 7), 30 days (level 8), 366 days (level 9).

name: Mental Prison
description: You attempt to bind a creature within an illusory cell that only it perceives. One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw (creatures immune to being Charmed succeed automatically). On a failed save, the target takes 5d10 Psychic damage and is Restrained in an illusory environment—a prison of fire, void, or another daunting scene of your choice. If the target is moved out of the illusion, makes a melee attack through it, or reaches any part of its body through it, the target takes 10d10 Psychic damage and the spell ends. On a successful save, the target takes 5d10 Psychic damage and the spell ends.

name: Move Earth
description: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in it, raising or lowering elevation, creating or filling trenches, and so on. Changes take 10 minutes to complete; you can pick a new area every 10 minutes. The spell can't manipulate stone, and slow changes rarely trap or harm creatures.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
components: V, S, M (a miniature crystal sphere)
description: A frigid globe explodes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere at a point within range. Each creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 10d6 Cold damage on a failure or half on a success. Water it strikes freezes 6 inches deep. Alternatively, you can hold the globe for up to 1 minute and throw or sling it later; it explodes on impact.
higherLevel: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 6.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom save. On a success it dances comically until the end of its next turn, spending all its movement to dance in place. On a failure it is Charmed for the duration: it must dance in place, has Disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, other creatures have Advantage on attacks against it, and it can't take Reactions. It can take an action on each of its turns to repeat the save, ending the spell on a success.

name: Planar Ally
description: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid, and it sends a Celestial, Elemental, or Fiend loyal to it to appear within range. You can bargain with the creature to perform a service; it expects payment in proportion to the task's length and danger, and may refuse tasks against its nature.

name: Programmed Illusion
components: V, S, M (jade dust worth 25+ GP)
description: You create an illusion of an object, creature, or phenomenon within a 30-foot Cube that activates when a condition you specify occurs. It then plays out a scripted performance of up to 5 minutes, including sounds, then goes dormant for 10 minutes before it can trigger again. A creature that takes a Study action can make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to recognise it as illusory.

name: Scatter
description: The air quivers around up to five creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist this spell. You teleport each affected target to an unoccupied space that you can see within 120 feet of you. That space must be on the ground or on a floor.

name: Soul Cage
castTime: Reaction, which you take when a Humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver cage worth 100+ GP)
description: This spell snatches the soul of a Humanoid as it dies and traps it inside the tiny cage you use for the material component. A stolen soul remains inside the cage until the spell ends or until you destroy the cage, which ends the spell. You can exploit the soul up to six times; on the sixth exploitation it is released and the spell ends. Options: Steal Life (Bonus Action): regain 2d8 Hit Points. Query Soul: ask the soul one question telepathically and receive a brief truthful answer. Borrow Experience (Bonus Action): gain advantage on your next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw before the start of your next turn. Eyes of the Dead (Action): name a place the humanoid saw in life to create an invisible sensor there for up to 10 minutes of concentration.

name: Summon Fiend
components: V, S, M (a bloody vial worth 600+ GP)
description: You call forth a fiendish spirit that manifests as a Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth (your choice) using the Fiendish Spirit stat block. It is an ally that obeys your commands, acts immediately after you in combat, and vanishes at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.
higherLevel: Use the higher slot level wherever the stat block refers to the spell's level.

name: Sunbeam
description: A 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long beam of sunlight flashes from you. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 6d8 Radiant damage and being Blinded until the start of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success. You can create a new beam as a Magic action on later turns. You shed Bright Light (sunlight) in a 30-foot radius for the duration.

name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
components: V, S, M (a gilded ladle worth 500+ GP)
description: A claw-footed cauldron appears on the ground within 5 feet, filled with liquid that duplicates a Common or Uncommon potion of your choice. As a Bonus Action, you or an ally can withdraw one potion. It produces a number of potions equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 1); when the last is withdrawn, the spell ends. Unconsumed potions disappear when you cast this spell again.

name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
components: V, S, M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Outer Planes, worth at least 500+ GP)
description: Uttering an incantation, you draw on the magic of the Lower Planes or Upper Planes (your choice) to transform yourself. You gain the following benefits until the spell ends, based on your choice. Lower Planes: You sprout wings with a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You have resistance to Fire and Poison damage and immunity to the Poisoned condition. You have Darkvision out to 60 feet. The first time you hit on each of your turns with a weapon attack, the target takes an extra 2d6 Fire or Necrotic damage (your choice when you cast the spell). Upper Planes: You sprout wings with a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You have resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage and immunity to the Frightened condition. You have Darkvision out to 60 feet. The first time you hit on each of your turns with a weapon attack, the target takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice when you cast the spell).

name: Transport via Plants
description: You link a Large or larger inanimate plant within range to another plant of similar size at any distance on the same plane, which you must have seen or touched before. For the duration, any creature can step into the target plant and exit from the destination plant using 5 feet of movement.

name: True Seeing
components: V, S, M (mushroom powder worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: The touched creature gains Truesight, can perceive the Ethereal Plane, and notices secret doors hidden by magic, all out to 120 feet.

name: Wall of Ice
components: V, S, M (a piece of quartz)
description: You create a 1-foot-thick wall of ice made of up to ten 10-foot-square panels, or a hemispherical dome up to 10 feet in radius. Creatures in its space when it appears make a Dexterity save, taking 10d6 Cold damage on a failure or half on a success. Each 10-foot section has AC 12 and 30 HP; when destroyed it leaves frigid air that deals 5d6 Cold damage (Constitution save for half) to a creature moving through it for the first time on a turn.
higherLevel: Damage when the wall appears increases by 2d6, and the frigid-air damage by 1d6, per slot level above 6.

name: Wall of Thorns
components: V, S, M (a handful of thorns)
description: You create a wall of tangled, needle-sharp brush up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a circle up to 20 feet in diameter. It blocks line of sight. Creatures in its area when it appears make a Dexterity save, taking 7d8 Piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. Moving through the wall costs 4 feet per foot, and a creature entering it or ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save against 7d8 Slashing damage (half on success).
higherLevel: Both damage types increase by 1d8 per slot level above 6.

name: Wind Walk
description: You and up to ten willing creatures within range assume gaseous forms resembling wisps of cloud. In cloud form a creature has a Fly speed of 300 feet, can hover, has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and can only Dash or take a Magic action to revert. Reverting or resuming cloud form takes 1 minute, during which the creature is Stunned.

name: Word of Recall
description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You must first designate a sanctuary by casting this spell in a location dedicated to your deity, such as a temple.

name: Conjure Celestial
description: You conjure a spirit that manifests as a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of Bright Light. Each creature you can see in it when it appears, that the Cylinder moves into, or that enters it or ends its turn there, can be bathed in one of two lights (a creature only once per turn). When you move on your turn, you can move the Cylinder up to 30 feet.

subEntries.label: Healing Light
subEntries.text: The target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

subEntries.label: Searing Light
subEntries.text: The target makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.

higherLevel: Healing and damage increase by 1d12 per slot level above 7.

name: Crown of Stars
description: Seven motes of light appear and orbit your head until the spell ends. You can use a Bonus Action to send one of the motes streaking toward one creature or object within 120 feet of you. When you do so, make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 Radiant damage. Whether you hit or miss, the mote is expended. When all seven motes are expended, the spell ends. With four or more motes remaining, they shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. With one to three motes remaining, they shed dim light in a 30-foot radius.
higherLevel: Two additional motes are created for each slot level above 7th.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
components: V, S, M (a ball of bat guano and sulfur)
description: A glowing bead hovers at a point within range. When the spell ends, the bead explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere: each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Base damage is 12d6, increasing by 1d6 at the end of each of your turns while the bead remains. A creature can pick up the bead and throw it, possibly triggering it on impact.
higherLevel: Base damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 7.

name: Divine Word
description: You utter a word of divine power. Each creature of your choice you can see within range makes a Charisma save. On a failure, it suffers an effect based on its current Hit Points. A Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend that fails is also forced back to its home plane and can't return for 24 hours except by a Wish spell.

subEntries.label: 0–20 HP
subEntries.text: The target dies.

subEntries.label: 21–30 HP
subEntries.text: Blinded, Deafened, and Stunned for 1 hour.

subEntries.label: 31–40 HP
subEntries.text: Blinded and Deafened for 10 minutes.

subEntries.label: 41–50 HP
subEntries.text: Deafened for 1 minute.

name: Dream of the Blue Veil
components: V, S, M (a magic item or a willing creature from the destination world)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range fall unconscious for the spell's duration and experience visions of another world on the Material Plane (such as Toril, Eberron, or Krynn). If the spell reaches its full duration, the visions conclude with each of those creatures feeling a sensation of teleportation, and the spell conjures a portal connecting your current location to a random location on the destination world. Each creature in the vision then appears in a space within 20 feet of the portal on the destination world. A creature that is killed while asleep and in the vision dies. If a creature is awoken before the spell concludes, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 20, +1 per hour of dream). On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of you for 1d4 minutes.

name: Etherealness
description: You step into the Border Ethereal. You can see the plane you left (it appears gray, vision limited to 60 feet) and can move in any direction, but moving up or down costs an extra foot per foot. You can affect and be affected only by things on the Ethereal Plane. When the spell ends you return to the corresponding spot; if it is occupied, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take 2 Force damage per foot moved.
higherLevel: You can target up to three additional willing creatures within 10 feet of you per slot level above 7.

name: Finger of Death
description: One creature makes a Constitution save: 7d8 + 30 Necrotic on a fail, half on success. A Humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a Zombie under your command.

name: Fire Storm
description: A storm of fire fills up to ten 10-foot Cubes you arrange within range; each Cube must share a face with another. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 7d10 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects not being worn or carried catch fire.

name: Forcecage
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: An immobile, invisible, Cube-shaped prison of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose: a cage up to 20 feet on a side with bars spaced 1/2 inch apart, or a solid box up to 10 feet on a side. Creatures inside can't leave by nonmagical means. A creature trying to teleport or travel between planes to escape must first succeed on a Charisma save. The prison can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic.

name: Mirage Arcane
description: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. Illusory features can be touched and used, so illusory bridges can be crossed and illusory walls block movement. Creatures with Truesight see through the illusion but can still physically interact with it.

name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
components: V, S, M (a miniature door worth 15+ GP)
description: You conjure a shimmering door to an extradimensional dwelling of up to 50 contiguous 10-foot Cubes, furnished as you choose, with a staff of 100 near-transparent servants and a nine-course banquet for 100 people. You decide who may enter. Anything taken from the mansion vanishes, and creatures inside when the spell ends appear near the entrance.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
components: V, S, M (a miniature sword worth 250+ GP)
description: You create a spectral sword that hovers within range. When it appears, make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of it; on a hit, the target takes 4d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier Force damage. On later turns you can take a Bonus Action to move the sword up to 30 feet and repeat the attack.

name: Plane Shift
components: V, S, M (a forked, metal rod worth 250+ GP and attuned to a plane of existence)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence, arriving in or near a destination you specify in general terms (GM's choice). Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane, you arrive at that circle (or the closest unoccupied spaces next to it).

name: Power Word Fortify
description: You fortify up to six creatures you can see within range, dividing 120 Temporary Hit Points among them however you like.

name: Power Word Pain
description: You speak a word of power that causes waves of intense pain to assail one creature you can see within range. If the target has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it is subject to crippling pain. Otherwise, the spell has no effect on it. A target also unaffected if it is immune to being Charmed. While subject to crippling pain, any speed the creature has is no more than 10 feet. It also has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws other than Constitution saving throws. If it tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 10 + the spell's level) or the casting fails and the spell is wasted. The target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Prismatic Spray
description: Eight rays of light flash from you in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity save and rolls 1d8 to determine which ray affects it. Damaging rays deal 12d6 damage on a failed save, or half on a success.

subEntries.label: 1 Red
subEntries.text: Fire damage.

subEntries.label: 2 Orange
subEntries.text: Acid damage.

subEntries.label: 3 Yellow
subEntries.text: Lightning damage.

subEntries.label: 4 Green
subEntries.text: Poison damage.

subEntries.label: 5 Blue
subEntries.text: Cold damage.

subEntries.label: 6 Indigo
subEntries.text: On a failed save the target is Restrained and repeats a Constitution save each turn; three successes end it, three failures leave it Petrified.

subEntries.label: 7 Violet
subEntries.text: On a failed save the target is Blinded; at the start of your next turn it makes a Wisdom save or is transported to another plane of the DM's choice.

subEntries.label: 8 Special
subEntries.text: The target is struck by two rays; roll twice more, rerolling any 8.

name: Project Image
components: V, S, M (a statuette of yourself worth 5+ GP)
description: You create an illusory copy of yourself at a location within range that you have seen before. It looks and sounds like you but is intangible. As a Magic action you can move it up to 60 feet and make it gesture, speak, and behave as you choose, and you can see and hear through its eyes and ears. If it takes any damage, it disappears and the spell ends.

name: Regenerate
description: The target regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points and then regains 1 HP at the start of each of its turns. Severed limbs and body members are restored after 2 minutes.

name: Resurrection
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You restore to life a creature that has been dead no longer than a century, didn't die of old age, and wasn't Undead. It returns with all Hit Points, poisons neutralized, mortal wounds closed, and missing body parts restored. It takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests, reduced by 1 each Long Rest. If it had been dead 365 days or longer, until you finish a Long Rest you can't cast spells and have Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

name: Reverse Gravity
components: V, S, M (a lodestone and iron filings)
description: Gravity reverses in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high Cylinder. Unanchored creatures and objects fall upward to the top of the area. A creature can make a Dexterity save to grab a fixed object within reach and avoid falling. Things that reach the top hover there, and fall back down when the spell ends.

name: Sequester
components: V, S, M (gem dust worth 5,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A willing creature or an object is hidden away, safe from detection. It is Invisible and can't be targeted by Divination spells, perceived through scrying, or detected by sensors. A creature is put into suspended animation (Unconscious, doesn't age or need food, water, or air). You can set a condition that ends the spell; it also ends if the target takes damage.

name: Simulacrum
components: V, S, M (powdered ruby worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You create a simulacrum of one Beast or Humanoid within 10 feet of you for the entire casting. It is a Construct with the original's statistics but half its Hit Point maximum, and it can't cast this spell. It is Friendly to you, obeys you, and acts on your turn; it can't gain levels or take Short or Long Rests. Its HP can be restored only by repairing it during your Long Rest (100 GP of components per HP, within 5 feet of you). It melts at 0 HP, and casting this spell again destroys any existing simulacrum you made.

name: Symbol
components: V, S, M (powdered diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You inscribe a nearly invisible harmful glyph on a surface or object that can be closed. You set a trigger; when triggered, the glyph glows, filling a 60-foot-radius Sphere with Dim Light for 10 minutes, and each creature in the Sphere when it activates, or that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, is subjected to its effect. Choose one effect:

subEntries.label: Death
subEntries.text: Constitution save: 10d10 Necrotic damage on a failure, half on a success.

subEntries.label: Discord
subEntries.text: Wisdom save: on a failure, the target argues with other creatures for 1 minute and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

subEntries.label: Fear
subEntries.text: Wisdom save: on a failure, the target is Frightened for 1 minute and must move at least 30 feet away from the glyph on each of its turns.

subEntries.label: Pain
subEntries.text: Constitution save: on a failure, the target is Incapacitated with excruciating pain for 1 minute.

subEntries.label: Sleep
subEntries.text: Wisdom save: on a failure, the target is Unconscious for 10 minutes, waking if it takes damage or is shaken awake.

subEntries.label: Stunning
subEntries.text: Wisdom save: on a failure, the target is Stunned for 1 minute.

name: Teleport
description: Instantly transport yourself and up to eight willing creatures you can see within range, or a single Large or smaller object not held by an unwilling creature, to a destination you know on the same plane of existence. The GM rolls 1d100 against your familiarity with the destination: a Mishap deals 3d10 Force damage to each traveler and rerolls, Similar Area lands somewhere alike, and Off Target lands 2d12 miles away.

name: Temple of the Gods
components: V, S, M (a holy symbol worth at least 5+ GP)
description: You cause a temple to shimmer into existence on ground you can see within range. The temple must fit within an unoccupied cube up to 120 feet on each side. It is dedicated to whatever deity you choose. The temple is made from opaque stone impervious to the knock spell. Its atmosphere is clean and comfortable. You can open and close exterior openings as a Bonus Action. Divination spells can't be cast into or out of the temple. You can designate which creatures may move through exterior openings. You can designate the interior as hallowed ground (as the hallow spell). The temple lasts for the duration, then vanishes.

name: Whirlwind
description: A whirlwind howls down to a point that you can see on the ground within range. The whirlwind is a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder. Until the spell ends, you can use your action to move the whirlwind up to 30 feet along the ground. The whirlwind sucks up any Medium or smaller objects that aren't secured or worn. Each creature in the whirlwind's space must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much. A Large or smaller creature must also succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Restrained in the whirlwind. A Restrained creature is pulled 5 feet higher each turn (unless at the top) and falls when the spell ends. It can use an action to make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC to escape, then is hurled 3d6 × 10 feet in a random direction.

name: Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting
components: V, S, M (a bit of sponge)
description: You draw the moisture from every creature in a 30-foot cube centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead aren't affected, and Plants and water elementals make this saving throw with disadvantage. A creature takes 12d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

name: Animal Shapes
description: Choose any number of willing creatures you can see in range and transform each into a Large or smaller Beast of Challenge Rating 4 or lower. Targets keep their creature type, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, mental scores, and ability to communicate, but can't cast spells. Each gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form it takes; any left vanish when the spell ends. On later turns, you can take a Magic action to change their forms again. A target can end its transformation as a Bonus Action.

name: Antimagic Field
description: A 10-foot Emanation of antimagic surrounds you. No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create magical effects inside it, and such things can't affect anything inside. Magic items' properties don't work in it, areas of magic can't extend into it, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Ongoing spells are suppressed (time still counts against their duration), except those from an Artifact or deity. Dispel Magic has no effect on it.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
components: V, S, M (a mix of vinegar and honey)
description: You enchant a Huge or smaller creature or object and name a kind of creature. A creature of that kind makes a Wisdom save when it comes within 120 feet of the target. If an affected creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away, it makes a Wisdom save, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune for 1 minute.

subEntries.label: Antipathy
subEntries.text: On a failure, the creature is Frightened and must use its movement to get as far from the target as possible by the safest route.

subEntries.label: Sympathy
subEntries.text: On a failure, the creature is Charmed and must use its movement to get as close to the target as possible; within 5 feet it can't willingly move away. If the target damages it, it can make a Wisdom save to end the effect.

name: Befuddlement
components: V, S, M (a key ring with no keys)
description: You blast a creature's mind. It makes an Intelligence save: on a failure, it takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action; on a success, half damage only. Every 30 days the creature can repeat the save to end the effect, which can also be ended by Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish.

name: Clone
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes, and a sealable vessel worth 2,000+ GP that is large enough to hold the creature being cloned)
description: You touch a creature or at least 1 cubic inch of its flesh. An inert duplicate forms inside the vessel and finishes growing after 120 days; you choose whether it is the same age or younger. It endures indefinitely while the vessel is undisturbed. If the original dies after the clone is finished, its soul transfers to the clone if free and willing, with the same memories and abilities but none of its equipment.

name: Control Weather
description: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you; you must be outdoors, and the spell ends if you go indoors. You can shift precipitation, temperature, and wind by one stage on the relevant tables (and change wind direction), with each change taking 1d4 × 10 minutes to take effect. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.

name: Demiplane
description: A shadowy Medium door appears on a flat surface, leading to an empty 30-foot Cube room of wood or stone on a demiplane. When the spell ends, the door vanishes; objects inside remain, and creatures inside remain unless they opt to be shunted out, landing Prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces. Each casting can create a new demiplane or connect to one you made before, or to another caster's if you know its nature and contents.

name: Dominate Monster
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or has the Charmed condition; it has Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever it takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on a success. While Charmed, you have a telepathic link and can issue commands on your turn (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can make it take a Reaction by using your own Reaction.
higherLevel: With a level 9 spell slot, Concentration can last up to 8 hours.

name: Earthquake
description: A 100-foot-radius circle of ground shakes violently and becomes Difficult Terrain. When you cast it and at the end of each of your turns, each creature on the ground there makes a Dexterity save or is knocked Prone and loses Concentration. 1d6 fissures can open (Dexterity save or fall in), and structures take 50 Bludgeoning damage each turn; a collapsing structure deals 12d6 Bludgeoning damage to nearby creatures (Dexterity save for half) and buries them on a failure.

name: Glibness
description: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Also, no matter what you say, magic that would determine whether you're telling the truth indicates you are truthful.

name: Holy Aura
components: V, S, M (a reliquary worth 1,000+ GP)
description: You emit an aura in a 30-foot Emanation. Creatures of your choice in it have Advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them. When a Fiend or Undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack roll, it makes a Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Illusory Dragon
description: By gathering threads of shadow material from the Shadowfell, you create a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. When the illusion appears, any of your enemies that can see it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened of it for 1 minute. As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 60 feet. At any point during its movement, you can cause it to exhale a blast of energy in a 60-foot cone from its position. Each creature in the cone must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 7d6 damage (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison—your choice) on a failed save, or half on a success. The illusion is immune to all damage, automatically succeeds on saving throws, and attacks against it automatically miss. A creature can use its action to examine it and determine it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

name: Incendiary Cloud
description: A swirling cloud of embers fills a 20-foot-radius Sphere, which is Heavily Obscured. A creature in it when it appears, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success (once per turn). The cloud moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

name: Maddening Darkness
components: V, M (a drop of pitch mixed with a drop of mercury)
description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 60-foot-radius sphere until the spell ends. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with Darkvision can't see through this darkness. Nonmagical light, as well as light created by spells of 8th level or lower, can't illuminate the area. Shrieks, gibbering, and mad laughter can be heard within the sphere. Whenever a creature starts its turn in the sphere, it must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 8d8 Psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

name: Maze
description: You banish a creature you can see into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target can take a Study action to make a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check; on a success, it escapes. When the spell ends, it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Mighty Fortress
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A fortress of stone erupts from a square area of ground of your choice that you can see within range. The area is 120 feet on each side, must not have any existing structures, and any creatures in the area are harmlessly lifted up as the fortress rises. The fortress has four 20-foot-square, 30-foot-tall turrets at the corners, connected by stone walls 80 feet long, 1 foot thick, and 10 feet tall, enclosing the area. You can place up to four stone buildings inside the enclosed area. Small and larger creatures can't pass through the outer walls from outside, but can exit freely. You decide all details of the fortress's exterior and interior when you cast this spell.

name: Mind Blank
description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Immunity to Psychic damage and the Charmed condition. It is also unaffected by anything that would sense its emotions or alignment, read its thoughts, or magically detect its location, and no spell (not even Wish) can gather information about it, observe it remotely, or control its mind.

name: Power Word Stun
description: You overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see. If it has 150 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Stunned condition; otherwise, its Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. The Stunned target makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

name: Sunburst
components: V, S, M (a piece of sunstone)
description: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save: on a failure, 12d6 Radiant damage and Blinded for 1 minute; on a success, half damage only. A Blinded creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The spell dispels magical Darkness in its area.

name: Telepathy
components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
description: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature familiar to you on the same plane. You can instantly share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages, and the creature knows who you are. The link works even if you share no language.

name: Tsunami
description: A wall of water up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick appears. Each creature in it makes a Strength save, taking 6d10 Bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. At the start of each of your later turns, the wall moves 50 feet away from you with creatures in it; each Huge or smaller creature in it or in its path makes a Strength save or takes 5d10 Bludgeoning damage (once per round). After each turn, its height drops by 50 feet and later damage by 1d10; it ends at 0 feet. Creatures inside must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to swim.

name: Astral Projection
components: V, S, M (for each of the spell's targets, one jacinth worth 1,000+ GP and one silver bar worth 100+ GP, all of which the spell consumes)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane. Bodies left behind are Unconscious in suspended animation. Each astral form copies its statistics and possessions and is tethered by a silvery cord; if the cord is cut, the body and form both die. If an astral form leaves the Astral Plane, its body travels to rejoin it. The spell ends for a target if its body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points, and for everyone if you dismiss it as a Magic action.

name: Blade of Disaster
description: You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The blade lasts for the duration. When you create the blade, you can make up to two melee spell attacks with it against targets within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 Force damage. This attack scores a critical hit if the number on the d20 is 18 or higher. On a critical hit, the blade deals an extra 8d12 Force damage (12d12 total). As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can move the blade up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see and then make up to two melee spell attacks with it again.

name: Foresight
description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, it has Advantage on D20 Tests, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against it. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

name: Gate
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 5,000+ GP)
description: You open a circular portal 5 to 20 feet in diameter linking your location to a precise spot on another plane. Travel through it is possible only from its front. If you name a specific creature when casting, the portal opens next to it and draws it through to your side; you gain no special control over it. Deities and other planar rulers can prevent portals from opening in their domains.

name: Imprisonment
components: V, S, M (a statuette of the target worth 5,000+ GP)
description: You magically restrain a creature you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be imprisoned in one of the forms below; on a success it is immune to this spell for 24 hours. While imprisoned it doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, doesn't age, can't teleport, and can't be located by Divination spells. When you cast the spell, you specify an observable trigger that ends it (likely within a decade); Dispel Magic cast with a level 9 slot can also end it.

subEntries.label: Burial
subEntries.text: The target is entombed far beneath the earth in a sphere of magical force.

subEntries.label: Chaining
subEntries.text: Chains rooted in the ground hold the target in place; it is Restrained and can't move by any means.

subEntries.label: Hedged Prison
subEntries.text: The target is transported into a tiny demiplane warded against teleportation and planar travel.

subEntries.label: Minimus Containment
subEntries.text: The target shrinks to 1 inch and is trapped inside a gemstone or similar object.

subEntries.label: Slumber
subEntries.text: The target has the Unconscious condition and can't be awoken.

name: Invulnerability
components: V, S, M (a small piece of adamantine worth at least 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You are immune to all damage until the spell ends.

name: Mass Heal
description: A flood of healing energy restores up to 700 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell also have the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions removed.

name: Mass Polymorph
description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the transformation. An unwilling shapechanger automatically succeeds on the save. Each target assumes a beast form of your choice (same or different for each), which must be a beast you have seen whose CR is equal to or less than the target's CR or half its level. The target's statistics are replaced by the beast's, except for its Hit Points, alignment, and personality. The target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the beast form's Hit Points. It reverts when those Temporary Hit Points are exhausted or it dies. When the spell ends, the creature loses its Temporary Hit Points and reverts to its normal form.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius Sphere centered on each point makes a Dexterity saving throw: 20d6 Fire damage and 20d6 Bludgeoning damage on a failure, half on a success. A creature in more than one Sphere is affected only once. Flammable objects not being worn or carried catch fire.

name: Power Word Heal
description: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see, restoring all its Hit Points. If it has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, that condition ends. If it is Prone, it can use its Reaction to stand up.

name: Power Word Kill
description: You compel one creature you can see to die. If the target has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 12d12 Psychic damage.

name: Prismatic Wall
description: A multicolored opaque wall up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick (or a globe up to 30 feet across) appears, shedding Bright Light for 100 feet and Dim Light 100 feet beyond. You and creatures you designate pass safely. Another creature that can see it and moves within 20 feet or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save or is Blinded for 1 minute. A creature passing through makes a Dexterity save against each of the seven layers in turn (half damage on a success). The wall has AC 10; layers are destroyed in order from red to violet. Antimagic Field has no effect, and Dispel Magic affects only violet.

subEntries.label: Red
subEntries.text: 12d6 Fire damage. Blocks nonmagical ranged attacks. Destroyed by 25+ Cold damage.

subEntries.label: Orange
subEntries.text: 12d6 Acid damage. Blocks magical ranged attacks. Destroyed by a strong wind.

subEntries.label: Yellow
subEntries.text: 12d6 Lightning damage. Destroyed by 60+ Force damage.

subEntries.label: Green
subEntries.text: 12d6 Poison damage. Destroyed by Passwall or a similar spell.

subEntries.label: Blue
subEntries.text: 12d6 Cold damage. Destroyed by 25+ Fire damage.

subEntries.label: Indigo
subEntries.text: Restrained; Constitution save at the end of each of its turns. Three successes end it; three failures leave it Petrified until freed (e.g., Greater Restoration). Blocks spells. Destroyed by Bright Light from Daylight.

subEntries.label: Violet
subEntries.text: Blinded; Wisdom save at the start of your next turn. Success ends it; failure ends it and teleports the creature to another plane. Destroyed by Dispel Magic.

name: Psychic Scream
description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. Creatures with an Intelligence of 2 or lower are unaffected. Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 Psychic damage and is Stunned. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Stunned. If a target is killed by this damage, its head explodes. A Stunned target can make an Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Stunned condition on a success.

name: Shapechange
components: V, S, M (a jade circlet worth 1,500+ GP)
description: You shape-shift into a creature you have seen whose Challenge Rating is no higher than your level or CR (not a Construct or Undead). You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form; any left vanish when the spell ends. Your statistics are replaced by the form's, but you keep your creature type, alignment, personality, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, proficiencies, ability to communicate, and Spellcasting feature. You choose whether equipment drops or resizes. As a Magic action, you can change into a different eligible form.

name: Storm of Vengeance
description: A churning storm cloud 300 feet in radius forms centered on a point in range. Each creature under the cloud when it appears makes a Constitution save or takes 2d6 Thunder damage and is Deafened for the duration. At the start of each of your later turns, the storm produces a new effect.

subEntries.label: Turn 2
subEntries.text: Acidic rain falls. Each creature and object under the cloud takes 4d6 Acid damage.

subEntries.label: Turn 3
subEntries.text: You call six bolts of lightning, each striking a creature or object you choose; each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d6 Lightning damage on a failure, half on a success.

subEntries.label: Turn 4
subEntries.text: Hailstones rain down. Each creature under the cloud takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage.

subEntries.label: Turns 5–10
subEntries.text: Gusts and freezing rain: the area is Difficult Terrain and Heavily Obscured, each creature takes 1d6 Cold damage, ranged weapon attacks are impossible, and strong winds disperse gases and fog.

name: Time Stop
description: Time briefly stops for everyone but you. You take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row during which you can act and move normally. The spell ends if any action you use or effect you create affects a creature other than you or an object worn or carried by someone else, or if you move more than 1,000 feet from where you cast it.

name: True Polymorph
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke)
description: Choose one creature or nonmagical object (not worn or carried) you can see. You transform a creature into a different creature or an object, or an object into a creature. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom save to avoid it. If you maintain Concentration for the full duration, it lasts until dispelled. A new creature form's CR can't exceed the target's CR or level; the target keeps its Hit Points, can't speak or cast spells, and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the form's HP (leftovers vanish when the spell ends). An object becomes a creature of CR 9 or lower, no larger than the object, that obeys you (control lapses after an hour).

name: True Resurrection
components: V, S, M (diamonds worth 25,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Restore a creature that died within the last 200 years (not from old age) with all its Hit Points. Closes all wounds, neutralizes poisons, cures magical contagions, lifts curses, and restores missing limbs and organs; an Undead is restored to its non-Undead form. If the body no longer exists, you can speak the creature's name to give it a new body, appearing within 10 feet of you.

name: Weird
description: You conjure terrifying phantasms in a 30-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature of your choice there makes a Wisdom saving throw: on a failure it takes 10d10 Psychic damage and is Frightened for the duration; on a success it takes half damage. A Frightened target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, taking 5d10 Psychic damage on a failure and ending the spell on itself on a success.

name: Wish
description: The mightiest spell a mortal can cast. You can duplicate any spell of level 8 or lower, ignoring all requirements including costly components. Alternatively, choose an effect: create a nonmagical object worth up to 25,000 GP, restore all Hit Points to you and up to 20 creatures, grant up to ten creatures permanent Resistance to a damage type or 8-hour immunity to one spell, swap a feat, force a reroll from the last round, or request something else from the GM (risky). Any use other than duplicating a spell causes stress: until a Long Rest, casting a spell deals 1d10 Necrotic damage per spell level to you, your Strength becomes 3 for 2d4 days, and there is a 33% chance you can never cast Wish again.
